# Healing, survival and resurrection — playtest interface

**REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED — selected scope only.** The [final notebook review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_HEALING_FINAL_CLOSURE.md) closes147 classified class passages plus6 individually reviewed ordinary spell objects. Those6 spells are now operational playtest drafts; the catalog has78 operational and770 unfinished entries. This is a bounded interface, not DD24 completion:131 additional semantic matches and healing content in other domains still need dispositions. Original cards/books are preserved.

[Exact source procedures](HEALING_DEATH_SOURCE_BINDINGS.md) · [Latest boundary decisions](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_HEALING_FINAL_BOUNDARIES.md) · [Supplement decisions](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_HEALING_SUPPLEMENT_REVIEW.md) · [Reference checks](HEALING_PLAYTEST_VALIDATION.json) · [Source integrity](HEALING_DEATH_SOURCE_VALIDATION.json)

## Distinct life operations

| Operation | Result | Restriction interface |
|---|---|---|
| Minimum-HP prevention | Preserve positiveHP instead of crossing a floor | Not HP gain; cannot create positiveHP from0 |
| Ordinary healing | Increase a living creature's normalHP | Apply modifiers, prohibitions, reserve and Critical ceiling |
| Direct state recovery | Specifically defined dying/Stable/HP recovery | Broad cannot-regain-HP applies; ordinary healing modifiers do not |
| Would-die replacement | Replace a pending death before it becomes final | Exact source eligibility; not a generic damage floor |
| Resurrection | Actually dead willing identity returns at printedHP | Separate life transition; actual corpse/soul blockers apply |
| Companion reconstruction | Restore a device/companion through its own source | No general creature resurrection permission |
| TemporaryHP | Separate nonstacking buffer | Not healing, stabilization or resurrection |

Names never select the operation. Phoenix Rebirth heals a still-living ally at0. Cleric Resurrection returns an actual dead identity. Ritual of Undeath's Ward replaces death; ordinary Death Ward is a positive-to-zero floor. Feign death and spirit manifestations are not death or resurrection.

## Damage quantities and resolution

| Quantity | Definition and use |
|---|---|
| resolvedDamage | After defenses, before tempHP; positive damage event iff greater than0 |
| tempAbsorbed | min(tempHP, resolvedDamage) |
| postTempDamage | resolvedDamage minus tempAbsorbed, uncapped by currentHP; Core Instant Death/Wounds |
| actualHpDamage | NormalHP lost to the packet after true prevention; recovery and state-assignment loss excluded |
| actualDamageDealt | NEW anti-overkill bridge: tempAbsorbed plus actualHpDamage; numeric actual-damage drains/reflections |

Ordinary “damages,” “takes damage” and “damaging hit” predicates use a positive resolved packet. Actual-HP wording (Burning Blood/Rewind Wound) uses actualHpDamage. Numeric actual-damage wording (Sanguine Rite/Echo Leech/Merciful Smite/Wound Eater/Gravebrand) uses actualDamageDealt. Source attack/hit predicates remain distinct.

Example: HP10/temp10 takes5: numeric actual damage5, actualHP damage0, positive packet. HP1 under a floor takes5: numeric0 but positive packet. HP3 takes12: numeric3, raw post-temp12. HP0 takes1: numeric0, positive packet and normal death-failure consequences.

Divine Judgment consumes its once-this-actual-target-turn entitlement on a positive packet, then reflects min(Cleric level, max(1, floor(actualDamageDealt/2))). Thus HP1-floor/numeric0 reflects1 and consumes; fully prevented resolved0 does neither. Wrathful Brand/Balanced Scales use the positive predicate where their source says damage occurred.

Resolve a damage event in this order:

1. Snapshot pre-event HP/tempHP/Wounds; resolve defenses, temp absorption and uncapped post-temp damage.
2. Core Instant Death uses postTempDamage minus preHP greater than or equal to effective maximum when reduced to0. It precedes ordinary floors. Open a legal would-die replacement; stop that packet's death procedure. No Wound save or zero-HP failure follows this branch.
3. If not Instant Death, resolve applicable true floors. They cannot raise an already0 creature. They preserve raw damage and attached conditions; a prevented drop creates no drop-only Wound trigger, but half-max/Maiming still applies.
4. Spiral-TouchedIII alone has a specific pre-Wound recovery exception. If positive-to-zero remains, spend its use, preserve that raw crossing trigger, attempt quarter-max direct recovery and apply phase-out. Broad HP-gain prohibition blocks the recovery but not the use/phase.
5. Resolve the one Core Wound save using original post-temp damage and pre-event Wounds. Fatal Wound death opens its own legal replacement window. Actual death ends Spiral phase; a successful independent Ward prevents actual death.
6. Resolve already-zero damage failures/death and its legal replacement window. A successful replacement stops skipped same-packet death branches; never replay a Wound/failure branch merely because replacement changedHP.
7. Finalize a newly surviving0 creature's dying/Stable/knockout state. Only an explicitly triggered post-zero Reaction such as Grace Reversal can act before ordinary zeroHP Reaction loss finalizes.
8. Resolve eligible post-zero Phoenix/Unyielding-style healing only if target still lives, followed by later triggers. This healing never retroactively reduces the triggering packet's numeric damage.

The affected creature chooses among simultaneously eligible offered survival effects, then rechecks remaining triggers. A paid Reaction spends its declared cost; a limited automatic survival use spends when its actual source resolves. A true floor preventing the crossing means Spiral's use is not spent. No generic extra Reaction or return from death is created.

For Ritual Ward, sufficient body and no explicitly unpreventable death are prerequisites. It can intercept Instant Death, fatal Wounds, third death-save failure, eligible direct death and lethal tracks. Positive pre-eventHP→1 is loss prevention and works through Decay. Already0 with HP gain prohibited instead becomes living Stable0: clear counters and establish a d4-hour recovery deadline immediately.

Freeze packetHpLossBeforeReplacement after true floors but before Ward. Ward metrics are min(packetHpLossBeforeReplacement, max(0, preHP minus replacementHP)); never include loss caused solely by assigning a lowerHP state. HP20 takes10 then fatal Wound/Ward1 means actualHP damage10, not19. HP5 takes100 then Ward1 means actualHP damage4, raw100.

Direct death (e.g. Wound EaterIII) produces no damage or Wound save. Its healing requires actual death; a Ward interception prevents that trigger without refunding the paid activation. False LifeI has only its printed floor and failed-death-save replacement modes sharing1/LR; it is not an all-causes Ward.

## ZeroHP permissions and start timing

A conscious but dying creature still rolls at each regular start unless Stable. Extra turns do not advance these regular-start deadlines. Further damage and actual death retain normal consequences.

Mage Undying Spellform partially overrides only zeroHP Unconscious/Incapacitated restrictions: normal speech, voluntary half-Speed movement, normal Action, legal spellcasting with that Action, and starting/maintaining concentration. No independent BA/Reaction. Existing concentration avoids automatic loss from zeroHP, but the triggering damage still requires its concentration save. Separate Stunned/Unconscious/Expedition5 or6/Silence and other restrictions still apply. Healing above0 ends the feature. Expiry at0 destabilizes, cancels the Stable recovery deadline and adds one failure; the third kills normally and permits only an eligible would-die replacement.

Oracle False LifeIII permits exactly one choice during the allowed zeroHP turn: move up to Speed, speak, or activate one Revelation. The latter uses its printed Action/BA/trigger (trigger must occur on that turn), costs and components. It can start concentration; the feature did not preserve earlier concentration. No independent actions accompany the choice.

False LifeV quarter-max direct recovery resolves at its next regular start before the death save. Blocked recovery leaves0 without invented stability; dead creatures do not revive. Spiral phase expires at its next regular start before normal start processing. Fate-BoundIV rerolls a failed death save before committing natural1/counters; use the new result. Its generic death-effect save bonus is not an ordinary death-save modifier. A natural20 whose1HP is blocked uses the previously reviewed Decay bridge: Stable0, cleared counters, immediate d4-hour deadline and preserved used-turn marker. It does not spend Ward. This differs from blocked False LifeV, which remains dying.

## Ordinary healing arithmetic

Determine legal source, recipients, costs, clocks and available entitlements before arithmetic. The helper receives already eligible modifiers; it does not acquire class powers or validate every source for its caller.

Pre-resolution modifiers include Words of Equilibrium's formula M, Zealot's Fervor +S, Throne's Grace +1/die capped S+M, Benevolent Spirits' eligible paid-technique +M, Life Prophecy maximizing dice, and Crane's applicable +S. Conditional add-ons include Ground, Radiance, Aura of Faith, Ember Mantle, Life Linked's rolled1d4, Ranger Healing Touch, Aura of Mercy, Garden's stored+1 and Tranquil Lotus Step.

First compute without conditional add-ons. Only if this preview actually restores at least1HP, recompute that same event once with its eligible add-ons. The preview changes no pools/uses. Base5 minus5 plus a conditional3 remains0; eligible pre-resolution Benevolent3 yields3. Multiple flat class bonuses use the strongest across both passes unless an explicit source exception allows stacking. Rolled extra dice/per-die changes are separate.

Within each permitted reduction plan: formula/bonuses; per-die adjustments; compatible exact fractional multipliers with one floor after multiplication; compatible flat reductions; floor at0; broad HP prohibition; maximum/Critical/reserve caps. Intrinsic Wound Eater and systemic Corrupted remain independent factors. Duplicate same-stat per-die penalties use the strongest. Dice remain dice when maximized/shared; flat Lay on Hands and stored numeric Echoes have zero healing dice.

Blight Totem cannot compound other local healing reducers. Compare systemic factors plus Totem-half alone against systemic factors plus all otherwise compatible local reducers; use the lower result. Compatible halves multiply, compatible distinct flat penalties add, duplicate same-profile groups use strongest. Suppressed reducers do not participate.

Every present, operative, applicable next-positive-healing reduction consumes exactly once when the final event commits if its pre-reduction HP potential was positive. This includes reducers whose arithmetic branch lost to Totem or whose actual gain was later blocked. Zero potential and suppressed records consume none. Two-pass preview never consumes twice.

Critical at3Wounds caps ordinary healing at max(1, effective maximum minus1); it is not a maximumHP reduction and healing cannot lower currentHP. Reserve spends only actualHP restored. A final heal8 with room3 spends3 reserve; blocked healing spends0, other activation costs remain paid. Revival/form changes/encounter starts do not replenish reserve.

## Recovery gates, triggers and loops

False Life curse gates another creature's healing SPELL: optional Insight vs RevelationDC; success permits; failed or declined check rolls d2,1 blocks HP and2 permits. Nonspell recovery and independent nonHP components remain distinct. Burning Blood blocks the cold-tagged HP-healing component only, not independent tempHP/stabilization/resurrection.

Actual positiveHP restoration is required for Radiance's cure, Renewal's Stamina, Sanctified Reprisal and Life Prophecy's RC trigger. Meditative Healing's laterKi and Transcendent Meditation's second-pulseKi are independent components and still resolve when healing caps/blocks. Blood Tithe uses its actual qualifying hostile Bleed-death trigger and finite use; not staged farming.

Passive regeneration includes Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer's modification; these retain Reserve. Finite paid/limited pulses such as Aura of Grace, Living Pulse, Renewal Totem, Blood Feast, Exsanguinate, Hemostasis, Transcendent Meditation, Cellular Reconstruction and Adrenal Floodgate are not passive regeneration. Their own Downed/Incapacitated gates remain. A passive-regeneration prohibition is not a universal healing prohibition.

Lay on Hands retains its5×Paladin-level finite pool and ordinary Long Rest refill. Base Action spends at most level on one target; Hero1/LR spends the entire remaining pool across at most3, each allocation at least1. No RP conversion. ## Excess healing

OrdinaryMissingHP = effective maximum minus currentHP. Genuine excess is max(0, legal post-reduction healing minus OrdinaryMissingHP). Broad HP prohibition makes legal healing and excess0. Critical's ceiling does not redefine missingHP: max20/HP19/Critical/legalheal10 restores0 but has9 genuine excess; the missing1 is not excess. At HP20, legalheal10 has10 excess.

This quantity alone grants no conversion. A legal converter must satisfy its own costs/caps/cadences. One excess point can fund only one conversion. Source-internal Overflowing Light resolves before outside Cosmic Equilibrium uses remaining excess. Channel Life attaches a packet-wide prohibition on ALL excess-to-tempHP conversion, including another owner's feature. It permits an otherwise eligible Cosmic damage conversion.

**NEW agreed source exclusion:** Unpaid passive regeneration bounded by Mutation Recovery Reserve cannot supply excess-healing conversions unless a future source explicitly grants an exception. This covers Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer as a Bloodthick modifier. FullHP/Critical may compute mathematical excess but grants no Cosmic conversion and spends no Reserve. ReturnedHP is a life transition, unaffected by ordinary healing multipliers or generic living HP-gain prohibitions. Explicit corpse-local and identity/soul blockers are different scopes.

Preserve Wounds/Injuries, Corruption, intrinsic Oracle Curse, debt/legal-death/body claims and spent resources. ThreeWounds is Critical, not continuous automatic death. Clear death counters/Stable deadline but preserve used turn markers and persistent histories. No duplicate creature or resource refresh.

Both an actual resurrection and would-die replacement retain lethal tracks. Exhaustion6 becomes protected exhaustion.lethal-collapse: alive, Unconscious, no voluntary act/travel. Cures examine present, unexpired, not-ended records, including temporary suppression/acquired immunity. Initial immunity that prevented application leaves nothing to cure. Damage arbitration and active hooks still exclude suppressed/immune records.

A permitted per-record fire DEX ending save remains available while suppressed when a future tick remains; no extra save after the final consumed tick. ## Ability-check skills

| Ability | Skills |
|---|---|
| STR | Athletics |
| DEX | Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Stealth |
| INT | Arcana, Engineering, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion |
| WIS | Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival |
| CHA | Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion, Reputation |

There are 20 basic skills; CON has no default skill. A Director can call for another appropriate ability with a skill when circumstances justify it. Use the reviewed [core task procedure](CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md); attacks and ordinary saves remain distinct.

## Abilities and training

Ability modifier = floor((score − 10) / 2), including negative results. For example, 8 gives −1, 13 gives +1 and 16 gives +3.

**Optional new candidate method:** 27-point buy, scores 8–15 before ancestry. Costs are 8:0, 9:1, 10:2, 11:3, 12:4, 13:5, 14:7, 15:9. Spend no more than 27 points across six scores; no score outside that range. This adopts the existing companion method as a provisional option, not a claim that the book already specified it.

Resolve duplicate training as follows:

- For a selectable grant, choose another eligible option from that grant’s own list.
- For a fixed ancestry/background skill grant with no alternative list, choose another of the 20 basic skills.
- For a duplicated tool, choose another eligible tool from that grant’s list; if it has no list, use another actually supported tool in the same broad category.
- Duplicate armor, weapon, save or multiclass chassis training gives no skill or feat compensation. A new multiclass skill selection must still use its own permitted list.
- Duplicate proficiency never creates Expertise unless an exact feature says so. If a proficiency grant requires a choice and every legal option for that grant is already possessed, that grant provides no additional proficiency. Character creation, multiclass entry or advancement remains legal. Do not substitute a feat, Expertise, another category of proficiency, an unrelated skill/tool, or a banked future selection. This applies to skill and tool lists, including a legal replacement list or category that is itself exhausted.

PB is applied once to a check even if a skill and tool both qualify. An exact Expertise multiplier modifies that one proficiency contribution; it does not add another independent PB.
Research Team
Function: Studying artifacts, researching lore, identifying items, translating texts
Optimal Size: 1-3 members
Key Roles: Scholars, mages, historians
Considerations: Access to libraries, arcane tools, or specialized knowledge
Research Requirements

Ordinary spell research can be completed with Arcana and a laboratory. Matrix research cannot. The primary researcher must personally possess high ranks in multiple disciplines—Arcana, History, Religion, Nature, and Engineering—and must cross-reference rare drops, libraries, mechanisms, and seasonal changes. Archive knowledge may be inherited; cognitive continuity usually cannot.

value.title: Members, teams and offices
value.text:
An Expedition has at most **12 member characters**, including recruited NPCs and hirelings assigned independent Expedition jobs. Small Expeditions can use fewer teams and undertake feasible solo tasks. The following sizes are recommendations, not entry requirements.

| Team | Suggested members | Work |
|---|---:|---|
| Combat | 4–6 | Threats, battles and immediate protection |
| Reconnaissance | 1–3 | Scouting and mapping |
| Research | 1–3 | Study and identification |
| Resource | 2–4 | Gathering, crafting and harvesting |
| Support | 1–3 | Camp, care, repair and transport |

Appoint the five source offices: **Expedition Leader**, **Quartermaster**, **Routekeeper**, **Surgeon**, and **Claimant of Record**. The Leader represents the company and records tied organizational decisions; the Quartermaster tracks provisions, Load, cargo priority, wages and losses; the Routekeeper maintains the map; the Surgeon directs Wound treatment and casualty transport; the Claimant of Record maintains provenance, contracts and ownership documents. One person can hold several offices. An office grants no skill, extra Action or power over another player's consent or another owner's property.

Before work, record each member's primary activity or Rest, location, intended result, lead and assistants, and actual start/end times. Short tasks may follow one another. A person cannot perform incompatible activities during the same seconds. For a generic expedition task, up to three trained assistants who provide meaningful help each add +1. Exact crafting, harvesting, preservation, social and companion procedures use their own assistance rules instead.

Porters, bearers, guards and drivers contracted as members occupy roster seats. A public ship or caravan's external crew stays on its own service record and is not additional party labor or automatic combat support. Animals and source-bound noncharacter companions/devices do not occupy character seats; an intelligent creature recruited as an autonomous expedition character does. Larger forces use distinct cooperating Expeditions with real communication, shared finite resources and the same world clock.

Plain accessible speech or text in a known language needs no comprehension roll. That does not establish its truth, solve a code, authenticate it, reveal technical context or recover missing facts. Remembering a specific message understood through temporary magic preserves that information after the effect ends; general competence does not persist.

| Task | Procedure | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Copy visible characters | Actual access, tools, stock and time | A facsimile; no certified meaning or magical encoding |
| **NEW** ordinary prose translation | Source reading and destination writing; ten active minutes per 250 words, proportionately rounded up to a minute, minimum one | Plain noncoded prose in the destination language; no roll merely for translation |
| **NEW** uncertain recognition | One minute; normally INT/History, DC 10 familiar attested style, 15 supported related form, 20 damaged but diagnostic evidence | Supported identity or relationship; no translation |
| **NEW** Translate/Decipher project | One preregistered supported passage of at most 250 words; eight active hours; declared evidence, method, output and DC | Only the supported passage or cipher layer |

Routine obvious recognition needs no roll. A nondiagnostic specimen cannot reveal its identity through a high roll. Translation speed does not replace formula-copying, magical encoding or contract-authentication procedures.

For the eight-hour project, register the actual source meaning or finite supported meaning, relevant parallel/grammatical/key evidence and missing sections before work. Linguistic reconstruction uses INT/History: DC 15 supported related dialect, 20 unfamiliar but adequately evidenced language, 25 damaged yet recoverable correspondence. A separate mundane cipher uses INT/Investigation: DC 15 adequate known key, 20 constrained ordinary analysis, 25 difficult but genuinely solvable damaged/incomplete key. A plainly usable key may remove uncertainty; it does not provide a missing underlying language.

Declare one lead and one applicable PB contribution. **NEW project-specific assistance:** one qualified assistant contributes +1 after all eight hours of actually useful participation. This does not add assistants to other procedures. Apply the existing Core task degrees and natural shifts.

Success supplies only the registered supported result. Critical Success grants no second passage, fluency, extra meaning, code bypass or banked labor. Failure leaves notes and spent work, without a certified translation. Critical Failure has the same informational result plus only a genuinely predeclared, independently lawful hazard. No failure fabricates authoritative lore. An inaccessible or unsupported meaning makes the project unqualified before work; a destroyed gap stays a gap.

A fresh attempt requires genuinely new evidence or a concretely different supported method, and fresh required work. Changing readers, dates, copies or formatting alone does not create evidence or reset an unchanged failed attempt. Information genuinely discovered can support later work; past hours and rewards are never credited twice.

Formula research and copying retain their trade gates, DC, minimum research time and one-hour/1-sp copying rule. Scribing Insight uses its separate procedure below. A subject-limited background information feature is not general translation. Pending research/language feats give no current discount or bonus.

## Names, dialects and modes

Record spoken comprehension, speaking, reading, writing and script familiarity separately. Knowledge and current ability to use it are different: deafness may stop you hearing a language you know; it does not remove that knowledge.

**NEW permanent-grant convention:** a permanent ordinary grant saying “know,” “one language,” or a background language row grants spoken comprehension, speaking, reading and writing in the language's attested ordinary written form, unless expressly narrowed. Temporary understanding, basic ideas, fragmentary writing and magical communication give only their specific modes or meaning.

Orc and Orcish are one identity; Mycelic and Sporetongue are one. **NEW chosen interpretation of the book's option:** Imperial's Westreach, Eastern Sigil and Northern Vale use Common mechanically, while retaining their cultural/register labels. They do not consume extra choices or decode ciphers. “Mycelian” is an ancestry/legacy label, not an alias for Mycelic.

Trollish and Giant remain distinct. Deep Cant, Deep Speech, Murkish, Forgotten Script, Runic and Resonant Cant remain distinct. Shared letters, an ancient description or a similar name does not establish mutual comprehension or permission to select an otherwise restricted language.

**NEW Primordial policy:** general Primordial and Auran, Aquan, Ignan and Terran are independently known, related competencies. Knowing one does not automatically grant any of the others. Elemental-Touched chooses general Primordial **or** the dialect matching its already selected affinity: air/Auran, water/Aquan, fire/Ignan, earth/Terran. This fills one grant. Its Aquan is the same language an Amphibian knows. Other sources granting Primordial give general Primordial unless they expressly offer a dialect choice.

Gnomish and Orcish use Dwarvish script. Knowing its letters does not teach either language's grammar, meaning or cultural context. Where no named script is given, record a language-local orthography without inventing a lore name. **NEW written-competency completion:** Runic grants its attested written content; Forgotten Script must identify the actual admitted written tradition. Unspecified spoken forms remain unspecified. Recognizing or copying characters alone does not understand them.

No grant creates anatomy, a pheromone emitter, hearing, sight, hands, writing implements or a magical channel. Mycelic's description does not supply an invented biological ability. An ordinary flat ink page is not tactile-readable merely because its reader knows the language; an actual touch-reading spell exception has its own scope.

The published names The Voice and Resonant Cant retain their existing restrictions; this chapter grants neither ordinary enrollment nor an automatic class entitlement. Their meanings and deeper relationships remain deferred. No hidden-language list is created here.

citations.excerpt:
## Learn a language

**NEW ordinary course:** choose one language/dialect and the modes sought. Identify the learner, the relevant script, legitimate access, and an actual qualified instructor or a complete usable curriculum. An instructor needs the modes taught and a mutually usable channel. Self-study needs authentic explanations, examples, exercises and a way to check their meaning. An unknown inscription, an isolated translation, money or an Insight balance is not a curriculum. Spoken practice needs actual production and correction; comprehension-only magic does not supply it.

| Module | Active work |
|---|---:|
| Spoken comprehension and production | 240 hours |
| Literacy after knowing the language's semantics | 80 hours |
| Script/orthography portion included in that literacy | 40 hours |
| Script familiarity alone, without semantics | 40 hours |

A complete new spoken-and-written language requires **320 active hours**, or **280** with genuine prior knowledge of that same script. Literacy for a semantically known language takes 80 hours, or 40 with that script already known. A written-only language uses 240 hours of written semantics plus the 80-hour literacy module and grants only its attested written modes. Related dialects give no automatic discount. An explicit grant bypasses study only for the modes it actually grants; valid starting knowledge incurs no retroactive fee.

Credit complete **15-active-minute phases**. Interruption loses the unfinished phase's prospective credit; previous credit survives, while real time, materials and fees remain spent. A shorter final phase is allowed only to finish the exact module after a real source-specific adjustment. Missing instruction, access or a usable channel yields no progress. Log real losses separately. Administrative phases do not break actual concentration or evade Oracle Tongues' actual save and ten-minute loss.

**NEW tuition reference:** 1 gp per eight actual instruction hours, including ordinary lesson consumables the provider actually supplies. A real quote or voluntary teacher may differ. Self-study has no invented tutor fee but needs actual materials. Pay for actual instruction time, including time an interruption made unproductive. Round each actual final purchase once upward to copper; do not round every phase separately. Prepaid time and refunds follow the actual agreement. A price does not conjure a teacher, rare text, permission or equipment.

Use actual time within eight-hour Watches and the two-active-work-Watch ceiling, with governing rest, Strain and access limits. The tutor is occupied too. A minute cannot also fund guarding, travel, beneficial rest, crafting, research, another course, gaining Insight or spending Insight without an explicit rule allowing that concurrency. No calendar-day shortcut, INT/PB discount or pending feat applies.

Completion is deterministic after genuine required work and authentic final practice, included in the last required phase. There is no random final fluency roll, added examination period or completion fee. Record the acquired modes and their source. Gain no XP, PB, Expertise, formula, spell, rank, faction permission or another language. Partial study can establish particular recorded words; it does not satisfy a requirement to know the language.

**Example:** an Orcish-literate learner studies Gnomish with a qualified teacher and usable lessons. Shared Dwarvish script reduces the course to 280 hours, reference tuition 35 gp. A 40-minute lesson interrupted during its third phase gives 30 credited minutes but consumes 40 actual minutes; one invoice at the reference rate costs 9 cp. An applicable Tongues failure later removing ten credited minutes remains a real loss.

## Names, dialects and modes

Record spoken comprehension, speaking, reading, writing and script familiarity separately. Knowledge and current ability to use it are different: deafness may stop you hearing a language you know; it does not remove that knowledge.

**NEW permanent-grant convention:** a permanent ordinary grant saying “know,” “one language,” or a background language row grants spoken comprehension, speaking, reading and writing in the language's attested ordinary written form, unless expressly narrowed. Temporary understanding, basic ideas, fragmentary writing and magical communication give only their specific modes or meaning.

Orc and Orcish are one identity; Mycelic and Sporetongue are one. **NEW chosen interpretation of the book's option:** Imperial's Westreach, Eastern Sigil and Northern Vale use Common mechanically, while retaining their cultural/register labels. They do not consume extra choices or decode ciphers. “Mycelian” is an ancestry/legacy label, not an alias for Mycelic.

Trollish and Giant remain distinct. Deep Cant, Deep Speech, Murkish, Forgotten Script, Runic and Resonant Cant remain distinct. Shared letters, an ancient description or a similar name does not establish mutual comprehension or permission to select an otherwise restricted language.

**NEW Primordial policy:** general Primordial and Auran, Aquan, Ignan and Terran are independently known, related competencies. Knowing one does not automatically grant any of the others. Elemental-Touched chooses general Primordial **or** the dialect matching its already selected affinity: air/Auran, water/Aquan, fire/Ignan, earth/Terran. This fills one grant. Its Aquan is the same language an Amphibian knows. Other sources granting Primordial give general Primordial unless they expressly offer a dialect choice.

Gnomish and Orcish use Dwarvish script. Knowing its letters does not teach either language's grammar, meaning or cultural context. Where no named script is given, record a language-local orthography without inventing a lore name. **NEW written-competency completion:** Runic grants its attested written content; Forgotten Script must identify the actual admitted written tradition. Unspecified spoken forms remain unspecified. Recognizing or copying characters alone does not understand them.

No grant creates anatomy, a pheromone emitter, hearing, sight, hands, writing implements or a magical channel. Mycelic's description does not supply an invented biological ability. An ordinary flat ink page is not tactile-readable merely because its reader knows the language; an actual touch-reading spell exception has its own scope.

The published names The Voice and Resonant Cant retain their existing restrictions; this chapter grants neither ordinary enrollment nor an automatic class entitlement. Their meanings and deeper relationships remain deferred. No hidden-language list is created here.

Plain accessible speech or text in a known language needs no comprehension roll. That does not establish its truth, solve a code, authenticate it, reveal technical context or recover missing facts. Remembering a specific message understood through temporary magic preserves that information after the effect ends; general competence does not persist.

| Task | Procedure | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Copy visible characters | Actual access, tools, stock and time | A facsimile; no certified meaning or magical encoding |
| **NEW** ordinary prose translation | Source reading and destination writing; ten active minutes per 250 words, proportionately rounded up to a minute, minimum one | Plain noncoded prose in the destination language; no roll merely for translation |
| **NEW** uncertain recognition | One minute; normally INT/History, DC 10 familiar attested style, 15 supported related form, 20 damaged but diagnostic evidence | Supported identity or relationship; no translation |
| **NEW** Translate/Decipher project | One preregistered supported passage of at most 250 words; eight active hours; declared evidence, method, output and DC | Only the supported passage or cipher layer |

Routine obvious recognition needs no roll. A nondiagnostic specimen cannot reveal its identity through a high roll. Translation speed does not replace formula-copying, magical encoding or contract-authentication procedures.

For the eight-hour project, register the actual source meaning or finite supported meaning, relevant parallel/grammatical/key evidence and missing sections before work. Linguistic reconstruction uses INT/History: DC 15 supported related dialect, 20 unfamiliar but adequately evidenced language, 25 damaged yet recoverable correspondence. A separate mundane cipher uses INT/Investigation: DC 15 adequate known key, 20 constrained ordinary analysis, 25 difficult but genuinely solvable damaged/incomplete key. A plainly usable key may remove uncertainty; it does not provide a missing underlying language.

Declare one lead and one applicable PB contribution. **NEW project-specific assistance:** one qualified assistant contributes +1 after all eight hours of actually useful participation. This does not add assistants to other procedures. Apply the existing Core task degrees and natural shifts.

Success supplies only the registered supported result. Critical Success grants no second passage, fluency, extra meaning, code bypass or banked labor. Failure leaves notes and spent work, without a certified translation. Critical Failure has the same informational result plus only a genuinely predeclared, independently lawful hazard. No failure fabricates authoritative lore. An inaccessible or unsupported meaning makes the project unqualified before work; a destroyed gap stays a gap.

A fresh attempt requires genuinely new evidence or a concretely different supported method, and fresh required work. Changing readers, dates, copies or formatting alone does not create evidence or reset an unchanged failed attempt. Information genuinely discovered can support later work; past hours and rewards are never credited twice.

Formula research and copying retain their trade gates, DC, minimum research time and one-hour/1-sp copying rule. Scribing Insight uses its separate procedure below. A subject-limited background information feature is not general translation. Pending research/language feats give no current discount or bonus.

value.title: One clock, work and rest
value.text:
The campaign uses one elapsed clock. A Watch is eight hours; a day contains Morning, Afternoon and Evening Watches. Combat rounds, rests, travel, treatment and work occupy their actual time within that clock. Completing a task does not add a second Watch. Entering Haven, changing teams or starting initiative does not reset elapsed time.

A generic Watch task needs **480 active minutes** before its completion check. Feasible unfinished work can continue in another Watch, without a proportional completion reward. Exact recipes, uninterrupted training, treatment, rest and spells keep their own interruption rules. Guarding, travelling, casting, directing, interpreting, assisting or working cannot also count as incompatible rest. Passive carriage qualifies for rest only when a genuinely suitable safe berth and the actual rest requirements are satisfied.

Plan at most two active work Watches and one Rest Watch per person each day. Evening is the default Rest slot; change it prospectively before that day's first assignment. Voluntary extra noncrafting travel or guard duty can replace Rest and incur its real costs and Rest Debt. This supplies no third crafting, training, research or harvesting Watch. Emergencies still consume time and interrupt the activity underway.

Missing a scheduled Rest creates **Rest Debt**. If an emergency interrupts Rest, the debt opens after that emergency ends; otherwise it opens when the missed Rest Watch ends. Complete a qualifying safe eight-hour Rest by the end of the second following canonical Watch. If the debt remains unpaid at that deadline, gain 1 Strain once for that due event and keep owing the Rest. Missing another scheduled Rest while indebted gives 1 Strain and resets the deadline. There is no automatic additional Strain every second or every Watch merely because the same debt remains.

A safe eight-hour Rest clears the debt even when you cannot receive another Long Rest's benefits. Keep the separate limits: one beneficial Long Rest per 24 elapsed hours, two beneficial Short Rests between beneficial Long Rests, the existing four-hour Morale Rest, and 24-hour Haven care. Trance reduces sleep, not the eight-hour Long-Rest requirement. Use the actual Strain and recovery chapter for what can be removed.

value.title: One clock, work and rest
value.text:
Record nonnegative integer seconds from one campaign epoch. Watch w is [epoch + 28,800w, epoch + 28,800(w + 1)); a day is 86,400 seconds. Preserve Opening 2,400 hours and Horn 1,200 hours as literal scheduling receipts only. The Opening start is one recorded epoch event, not a fresh clock for each entry. This module supplies no post-Opening access or next-Cycle renewal and interprets no cosmology.

Measure actual work to the second and display minutes/hours. Generic interrupted progress remains only while physically feasible; actual loss can undo it. Travel's nominal tranche is distinct from its adjusted elapsed duration. No general Watch label changes an exact procedure's active-work requirements or crafting's own two-Watch productive ceiling.

At equal timestamps, use this order outside initiative:

1. Finish actual transfers/consumption and protection endings under their precise endpoint rules.
2. Evaluate due food/water support and blocks.
3. Complete qualifying rest/treatment; a safe Rest can clear debt here.
4. Process a still-unpaid debt deadline.
5. Settle completed activity/travel.
6. Coalesce extraction checkpoints.
7. Apply once-per-event/Watch Pressure and its bounded complication batch.
8. Run due faction/checkpoint reporting.

Combat's own expiration, death, start and periodic ordering controls inside initiative. Do not backdate supplies, protection, rest or rewards after learning an outcome. Stable recovery retains its original absolute deadline and does not replay at a Watch boundary. Later route, Pressure and faction modules supply their full procedures; this partial module does not substitute for them.

value.title: Haven work, services, learning and recovery
value.text:
A Haven Turn is **24 elapsed hours**, not a token that buys any result. Queue real workers, providers, facilities, materials and intervals. The normal day has two eight-hour productive Watches and Rest. Waiting is elapsed time, not productive labor or automatically beneficial rest. A Haven provides no teacher, workshop, buyer, cure, safe berth, food or license merely by being named.

Exact recipes keep all their gates, phases, assistant limits and hours—including a 960-hour order. “Brew a Batch in one day” is an activity label, not permission to finish a longer recipe. Repair, service, charging and creation remain distinct.

| Learning procedure | Retained requirement |
|---|---|
| Ordinary trade training | 80 active hours with qualified instructor; 10 gp tuition; actual tools/living costs; grants only its stated proficiency/trade 1/XP 0 |
| Ordinary spoken language module | 240 hours |
| Ordinary literacy module | 80 hours, including 40 for script |
| Full language with new script | 320 hours total |
| Full language with already known script | 280 hours total |

Language learning credits actual 15-minute phases, genuine instruction and the 1 gp per eight instruction-hour reference. A shared script or translated passage does not teach the language or a recipe. Keep actual Scribing Insight earning and the three-point/eight-hour supported-passage consultation, specific to its language. There is no universal Insight exchange or ordinary instruction purchase of combat feats/proficiencies. Class, spell and feat choices keep their real gates and pending status.

Short Rest, safe eight-hour Rest/beneficial Long Rest, four consecutive hours of voluntary Morale recreation, and 24 consecutive hours of full Haven care are separate procedures. Debt-clearing Rest inside the reward limit does not refill resources again. Actual compatible patients may rest during care; active practitioners cannot count the same work as their rest. Wound treatment retains eight hours, kit, one Supply and its actual result degrees. A Haven label neither removes a Wound nor bypasses the three-Wound healing ceiling.

Dependence recovery keeps its reviewed seven consecutive no-dose project days, each with one actual treatment hour and one Supply. The designated practitioner uses the chosen Medicine, Religion or Alchemy method and the final substance DC, or fallback 14 where applicable. Failure needs a fresh seven-day project. A qualifying eight-hour daily care activity includes that day's treatment hour, grants one nonstockpiled advantage on the next recovery check, and prevents only an actually defined ordinary escalation. It does not cure dependence automatically or alter crashes, doses or tolerance. Exact interruption rules still govern.

| Core service reference | Tiers I–III | Tiers IV–VI |
|---|---:|---:|
| Clean water, one mapped person-day | 1 cp | 1 sp |
| Ordinary hot meal | 2 cp | 5 sp |
| Qualifying eight-hour lodging/berth, per person | 5 sp | 5 gp |
| Verified map update | 1 gp | 25 gp |
| Preservation, per begun 10 lb accepted bill | 5 sp | 10 gp |
| Ordinary repair service | 10% of applicable undamaged reference | 15% |
| Actual escort journey, per floor/person | 2 gp | 50 gp |

These are available-provider offers, not automatic stock or extra fees on an inclusive bill. Water and meal quantities follow part 1. Lodging supplies a real qualifying stay, not automatic rest rewards. A map update takes one active desk hour using actual relevant records; it adds their true facts, not secured terrain or firsthand mapping marks. An escort needs its actual team, journey, food and availability, not a free additional army.

Preservation charges once per begun 10 lb of the accepted nonempty bill. The provider supplies compatible real inputs and the exact method/lot limits: use 30 minutes per lot and the 24-hour treatment where that is the governing method. Payment cannot preserve an unsupported active core. Ordinary repair service takes the actual qualifications and at least max(1 hour, maximum HP/10 hours); special Broken magic bodies retain their specific requirements. An inclusive service price replaces the self-repair material bill.

## Learn a language

Literacy for a semantically known language takes 80 hours, or 40 with that script already known. A written-only language uses 240 hours of written semantics plus the 80-hour literacy module and grants only its attested written modes. Related dialects give no automatic discount. An explicit grant bypasses study only for the modes it actually grants; valid starting knowledge incurs no retroactive fee.

A shorter final phase is allowed only to finish the exact module after a real source-specific adjustment. Missing instruction, access or a usable channel yields no progress. Log real losses separately. Administrative phases do not break actual concentration or evade Oracle Tongues' actual save and ten-minute loss.

**NEW tuition reference:** 1 gp per eight actual instruction hours, including ordinary lesson consumables the provider actually supplies. A real quote or voluntary teacher may differ. Self-study has no invented tutor fee but needs actual materials. Pay for actual instruction time, including time an interruption made unproductive. Round each actual final purchase once upward to copper; do not round every phase separately. Prepaid time and refunds follow the actual agreement. A price does not conjure a teacher, rare text, permission or equipment.

Use actual time within eight-hour Watches and the two-active-work-Watch ceiling, with governing rest, Strain and access limits. The tutor is occupied too. A minute cannot also fund guarding, travel, beneficial rest, crafting, research, another course, gaining Insight or spending Insight without an explicit rule allowing that concurrency. No calendar-day shortcut, INT/PB discount or pending feat applies.

Completion is deterministic after genuine required work and authentic final practice, included in the last required phase. There is no random final fluency roll, added examination period or completion fee. Record the acquired modes and their source. Gain no XP, PB, Expertise, formula, spell, rank, faction permission or another language. Partial study can establish particular recorded words; it does not satisfy a requirement to know the language.

A 40-minute lesson interrupted during its third phase gives 30 credited minutes but consumes 40 actual minutes; one invoice at the reference rate costs 9 cp. An applicable Tongues failure later removing ten credited minutes remains a real loss.

## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. **Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. ## Scribing, runes and devices

The reviewed [advanced operating guide](ADVANCED_CRAFT_CANDIDATE_GUIDE.md), [Scribing cards](../../data/crafting/advanced_craft_recipe_candidate_public.json) and [Tinkering cards](../../data/crafting/advanced_craft_recipe_candidate_public.json) retain their authority. The two card links open the supplied complete public advanced-crafting collection; use the actual recipe ID within it. Reading words does not establish a functional magical payload, caster eligibility or device control.

A properly encoded script supplies temporary repertoire for its one activation only to an otherwise qualified real caster who can read/understand its actual functional instructions. Class/rank/school, components, hand/access, RP and casting time still apply. Comprehension magic can meet only the eligible ordinary-language part of this test; its exclusions remain. Do not add the reference-consultation minute as an extra script casting cost.

A reference's bonus needs actual relevant content, availability and genuine necessary lead consultation of at least one minute, or the whole genuinely shorter task, under its self-production exclusion. Copying/translation makes an actual information copy, without transferring the original physical item's magic, charges, bonus or fresh study award. A printed zero-language effect remains zero.

The public **recipe-500** procedure awards one Language Insight after one active hour with legible, authenticated, genuinely useful parallel text into a language the researcher understands. Insight belongs to one researcher and target language, with a maximum of six unspent. Points cannot transfer to another researcher. The same underlying evidence awards once per reader across copies, holders, editions and magical recreations. Reaching the cap creates no deferred credit. Insight here is a specific ledger, separate from the Insight skill, XP or fluency.

Spend **three points for that language plus eight active hours** on one preregistered, supported, accessible and legible passage of at most 250 words, translating into a language the researcher knows. The Director must possess or establish its real source meaning. Missing meaning/evidence makes it unqualified before spending. This procedure adds no decipher roll. It grants the supported literal passage, without fluency, a separate cipher solution, hidden meaning, formula or spell. No hour also funds a course, a new Insight award, ordinary deciphering or formula work. A completed translation can later become genuine evidence; its old hours are not credited again.

Actor-specific verbal restrictions and a physical sound-suppression field differ. Neither automatically grants thunder immunity. Silence does not automatically end otherwise legal nonauditory concentration; a particular sustained audible performance may have stricter rules.

## Actual spell and ancestry interfaces

The [spell procedures](SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md) and [ancestry supplement](ANCESTRY_SPELL_SUPPLEMENT_PLAYTEST.md) remain controlling. The accompanying public language data contains the eight actual operative spell records without altering their access or status.

coreDamageDeath.excerpt:
Resolve each genuinely separate hit or damage event once. Do not split one packet to multiply Wound saves or combine separate hits merely to cross a threshold. Feature-specific prevention that acts before damage or before reaching zero resolves at its printed timing first.

1. Resolve attack/save, damage and applicable defenses. The remaining nonnegative amount is **resolved damage**.
2. Record HP, Wounds and zero-HP state before the event. Remove temporary HP first. **Post-temp damage = resolved damage minus temporary HP absorbed.** Keep this amount even when it exceeds current HP; floor the resulting current HP at zero.
3. Check V6 Instant Death. If post-temp damage minus HP before the hit is at least maximum HP, the creature dies. For a creature already at zero, this is post-temp damage at least maximum HP. Stop: there is no Wound save, death-save failure or successful knockout from that event.
4. Otherwise, a living creature makes one Wound save if it dropped from positive HP to zero, if **2 × post-temp damage is at least maximum HP**, or if the effect actually inflicts Maiming. Overlapping triggers still cause only one save. The post-temp threshold and one-save rule are new provisional interpretations. Maiming is an independent trigger even when temporary HP absorbs all ordinary damage; immunity to Maiming itself still applies.
5. Make a Constitution save against **max(10, floor(post-temp damage / 2))**. Use pre-event Wounds for the -1-per-Wound penalty. Maiming with zero post-temp damage uses DC 10. A Wound gained now cannot penalize the roll that created it.
6. A success adds no Wound. A failure that began with zero, one or two Wounds adds exactly one; failure by 5 or more also gives that Wound one Injury. A failure that began with three Wounds kills the creature instead: no fourth Wound and no Injury roll. Stop processing later living-target consequences if dead.
7. If the creature was already at zero before this event and post-temp damage is positive, end Stable. A creature using death saves adds one failure, or two for a critical hit; three failures kill it. An ordinary creature that does not use death saves dies instead, without starting death counters. A hit from positive HP to zero does not also cause a same-packet death failure.
8. If this event newly reduces positive HP to zero, a valid melee knockout makes the surviving creature Stable. Otherwise a character/significant NPC using death saves begins dying; an ordinary monster dies. A previously Stable creature whose temporary HP absorbed all damage remains Stable unless an independent Maiming result killed it. The Director identifies significant NPCs consistently. Knockout cannot override Instant Death or a fatal Wound save.

dazed.excerpt:
## Dazed

**Preserved Core text:** Choose either action or movement on the turn, not both; no bonus action.

**Effect:** On every affected turn, including extra turns, choose Action-mode (at most one Action total and no voluntary Speed expenditure or Dash) or Movement-mode (ordinary movement, no Action). Movement expressly included in the permitted Action still resolves. No Bonus Action; Reactions and concentration are unaffected.

**Application:** Only an effect that explicitly inflicts Dazed applies it.

**Duration and ending:** Use the applying effect's endpoint. Applies immediately: earlier voluntary movement that turn forbids further Actions; an earlier Action forbids further voluntary Speed expenditure; if both already occurred, neither may occur again. Do not undo completed events. Extra-Action grants cannot bypass the one-Action ceiling.

**Stacking:** Multiple Dazed applications do not further reduce the turn; track only the longest/independent ending sources.

**Immunities and specific exceptions:** An immunity to Dazed blocks application. Forced movement is not voluntary movement and remains possible.

value.title: One clock, work and rest
value.text:
The campaign uses one elapsed clock. A Watch is eight hours; a day contains Morning, Afternoon and Evening Watches. Combat rounds, rests, travel, treatment and work occupy their actual time within that clock. Completing a task does not add a second Watch. Entering Haven, changing teams or starting initiative does not reset elapsed time.

A generic Watch task needs **480 active minutes** before its completion check. Feasible unfinished work can continue in another Watch, without a proportional completion reward. Exact recipes, uninterrupted training, treatment, rest and spells keep their own interruption rules. Guarding, travelling, casting, directing, interpreting, assisting or working cannot also count as incompatible rest. Passive carriage qualifies for rest only when a genuinely suitable safe berth and the actual rest requirements are satisfied.

Plan at most two active work Watches and one Rest Watch per person each day. Evening is the default Rest slot; change it prospectively before that day's first assignment. Voluntary extra noncrafting travel or guard duty can replace Rest and incur its real costs and Rest Debt. This supplies no third crafting, training, research or harvesting Watch. Emergencies still consume time and interrupt the activity underway.

Missing a scheduled Rest creates **Rest Debt**. If an emergency interrupts Rest, the debt opens after that emergency ends; otherwise it opens when the missed Rest Watch ends. Complete a qualifying safe eight-hour Rest by the end of the second following canonical Watch. If the debt remains unpaid at that deadline, gain 1 Strain once for that due event and keep owing the Rest. Missing another scheduled Rest while indebted gives 1 Strain and resets the deadline. There is no automatic additional Strain every second or every Watch merely because the same debt remains.

A safe eight-hour Rest clears the debt even when you cannot receive another Long Rest's benefits. Keep the separate limits: one beneficial Long Rest per 24 elapsed hours, two beneficial Short Rests between beneficial Long Rests, the existing four-hour Morale Rest, and 24-hour Haven care. Trance reduces sleep, not the eight-hour Long-Rest requirement. Use the actual Strain and recovery chapter for what can be removed.

value.title: One clock, work and rest
value.text:
Record nonnegative integer seconds from one campaign epoch. Watch w is [epoch + 28,800w, epoch + 28,800(w + 1)); a day is 86,400 seconds. Preserve Opening 2,400 hours and Horn 1,200 hours as literal scheduling receipts only. The Opening start is one recorded epoch event, not a fresh clock for each entry. This module supplies no post-Opening access or next-Cycle renewal and interprets no cosmology.

Measure actual work to the second and display minutes/hours. Generic interrupted progress remains only while physically feasible; actual loss can undo it. Travel's nominal tranche is distinct from its adjusted elapsed duration. No general Watch label changes an exact procedure's active-work requirements or crafting's own two-Watch productive ceiling.

At equal timestamps, use this order outside initiative:

1. Finish actual transfers/consumption and protection endings under their precise endpoint rules.
2. Evaluate due food/water support and blocks.
3. Complete qualifying rest/treatment; a safe Rest can clear debt here.
4. Process a still-unpaid debt deadline.
5. Settle completed activity/travel.
6. Coalesce extraction checkpoints.
7. Apply once-per-event/Watch Pressure and its bounded complication batch.
8. Run due faction/checkpoint reporting.

Combat's own expiration, death, start and periodic ordering controls inside initiative. Do not backdate supplies, protection, rest or rewards after learning an outcome. Stable recovery retains its original absolute deadline and does not replay at a Watch boundary. Later route, Pressure and faction modules supply their full procedures; this partial module does not substitute for them.

exactEvidenceLocationsRead.excerpt: 1. Question. State what the researchers want to know in one sentence.
2. Sources. Require two or three source types: physical evidence, records, witnesses, experiments, or comparative samples.
3. Obstacle. Missing language, dangerous handling, political restriction, contamination, contradiction, or time.
4. Breakthrough. The answer changes a future decision, reduces a Gate cost, reveals a vulnerability, or creates a new question.
5. Exposure. Someone learns the research exists, an object reacts, or the process changes the researchers.
Failed Research

Failure should produce a partial answer, false confidence with visible warning signs, damaged evidence, faction attention, or a requirement for a new source. Pure “no result” wastes table time and discourages non-Combat roles.

value.name: Cantor’s Archive (Floor 47)
value.description: A hushed alcove lined with rune-etched lecterns and suspended crystalline lourdes that emit gentle harmonic drones. Shelves hold harmony-infused elixirs and tone-stones—each sip or brief resonance warding off creeping dissonance before facing Choralith itself.

exactEvidenceLocationsRead.excerpt: Forbidden is a legal, religious, or metaphysical classification, not a universal school. Soul destruction, involuntary identity alteration, Old One contact, permanent Gate rewriting, Unity resonance, and Matrical execution are forbidden because their consequences exceed the target. Casting such magic can create evidence, attention, Pact pursuit, or changes to the dungeon even when the spell succeeds.

Shaenira composed Lament Festival, annual convergence where sorrow is sung until transformed into gratitude. Bardic troupes, shamans, oracles joined, turning grief into kinetic sculpture that floated skyward, releasing communities from generational pain. Quorilith established Library of Shifting Sigils, pages rewriting as reader learns, ensuring knowledge remains living. Dra goons and monks consulted during strategems, discovering tactical manuals morphing when motive shifted from defense to conquest, forcing introspection. Thalxior created Paradox Forum within Vale of Concord, inviting Mirrorsages, crimson agents, soldiers to debate impossible dilemmas. Forum ranked responses by coherence rather than correctness, cultivating leaders adept at navigating ambiguity. Seraphon opened Gate of Gentle Departures at Argent threshold, guiding souls whose last act resonated with authenticity, regardless of virtue. A murderer who confessed truth might cross before hypocrite king whose lies rotted crown. Emergent mortal orders aligned with each archon site. Courage Circle of Ember Guardians, Balanced Hands Consortium, Crystal Pact Brokers, Lament Choristers, Sigil Navigators, Paradox Mediators, Threshold Guides. Each order blended classes cooperatively, demonstrating microcosm of lattice ideals.

### Tier 5 — Motion · Sanctum of Echoing Choirs (Floors 41–50)

**Principle:** Stagnation forbidden — geography shifts, rivers reverse, settlements migrate.

**Culture & travel:** Living-sound cathedral; whispers become symphonies. **Most expeditions end here.** Bar of Last Refuge (F43) is the pilgrimage turn-back shrine. Closer to Canticle Gate, calm and dread mix.

**Expedition goals:** Echo samples for Luminalis; Canticle Gate harmonic keys; Choir relics; **prestige** — surviving to Floor 50 before horn.

**Machine appetite:** **Forced movement** — parties that camp too long find havens relocated; stillness becomes lethal.

**Gate Guardian:** **Choralith, Voice Below**

**Key sites:** Whispering Pillars (F41) · Aeolian Mirror Pools (F42) · Bar of Last Refuge (F43) · Cantor's Archive (F47) · Canticle Gate (F50)

**Adventure seeds**

1. **Last Drink** — Bar of Last Refuge bartender offers **safe passage home** in exchange for unmapped Choir notes — the writ is infernal.  
2. **Four Notes** — Whispering Pillars sequence must be struck at Canticle Gate; a deaf Support specialist holds the only copy.  
3. **Horn Eve** — Day 49: party at Bar debates push; NPC veterans describe Day 50 horn **inside** the Sanctum — the sound comes from below, not above.

value.title: Haven work, services, learning and recovery
value.text:
A Haven Turn is **24 elapsed hours**, not a token that buys any result. Queue real workers, providers, facilities, materials and intervals. The normal day has two eight-hour productive Watches and Rest. Waiting is elapsed time, not productive labor or automatically beneficial rest. A Haven provides no teacher, workshop, buyer, cure, safe berth, food or license merely by being named.

Exact recipes keep all their gates, phases, assistant limits and hours—including a 960-hour order. “Brew a Batch in one day” is an activity label, not permission to finish a longer recipe. Repair, service, charging and creation remain distinct.

| Learning procedure | Retained requirement |
|---|---|
| Ordinary trade training | 80 active hours with qualified instructor; 10 gp tuition; actual tools/living costs; grants only its stated proficiency/trade 1/XP 0 |
| Ordinary spoken language module | 240 hours |
| Ordinary literacy module | 80 hours, including 40 for script |
| Full language with new script | 320 hours total |
| Full language with already known script | 280 hours total |

Language learning credits actual 15-minute phases, genuine instruction and the 1 gp per eight instruction-hour reference. A shared script or translated passage does not teach the language or a recipe. Keep actual Scribing Insight earning and the three-point/eight-hour supported-passage consultation, specific to its language. There is no universal Insight exchange or ordinary instruction purchase of combat feats/proficiencies. Class, spell and feat choices keep their real gates and pending status.

Short Rest, safe eight-hour Rest/beneficial Long Rest, four consecutive hours of voluntary Morale recreation, and 24 consecutive hours of full Haven care are separate procedures. Debt-clearing Rest inside the reward limit does not refill resources again. Actual compatible patients may rest during care; active practitioners cannot count the same work as their rest. Wound treatment retains eight hours, kit, one Supply and its actual result degrees. A Haven label neither removes a Wound nor bypasses the three-Wound healing ceiling.

Dependence recovery keeps its reviewed seven consecutive no-dose project days, each with one actual treatment hour and one Supply. The designated practitioner uses the chosen Medicine, Religion or Alchemy method and the final substance DC, or fallback 14 where applicable. Failure needs a fresh seven-day project. A qualifying eight-hour daily care activity includes that day's treatment hour, grants one nonstockpiled advantage on the next recovery check, and prevents only an actually defined ordinary escalation. It does not cure dependence automatically or alter crashes, doses or tolerance. Exact interruption rules still govern.

| Core service reference | Tiers I–III | Tiers IV–VI |
|---|---:|---:|
| Clean water, one mapped person-day | 1 cp | 1 sp |
| Ordinary hot meal | 2 cp | 5 sp |
| Qualifying eight-hour lodging/berth, per person | 5 sp | 5 gp |
| Verified map update | 1 gp | 25 gp |
| Preservation, per begun 10 lb accepted bill | 5 sp | 10 gp |
| Ordinary repair service | 10% of applicable undamaged reference | 15% |
| Actual escort journey, per floor/person | 2 gp | 50 gp |

These are available-provider offers, not automatic stock or extra fees on an inclusive bill. Water and meal quantities follow part 1. Lodging supplies a real qualifying stay, not automatic rest rewards. A map update takes one active desk hour using actual relevant records; it adds their true facts, not secured terrain or firsthand mapping marks. An escort needs its actual team, journey, food and availability, not a free additional army.

Preservation charges once per begun 10 lb of the accepted nonempty bill. The provider supplies compatible real inputs and the exact method/lot limits: use 30 minutes per lot and the 24-hour treatment where that is the governing method. Payment cannot preserve an unsupported active core. Ordinary repair service takes the actual qualifications and at least max(1 hour, maximum HP/10 hours); special Broken magic bodies retain their specific requirements. An inclusive service price replaces the self-repair material bill.

value.title: Haven work, services, learning and recovery
value.text:
Keep all 687 recipe creation/research/copying procedures, finite primary bodies/ingredients and source-specific charges. Parallel work requires distinct actual compatible workers. Real care, sleep, recreation and treatment may overlap only where the exact procedures allow them; active labor cannot be credited twice.

If no provider can furnish the published preservation price, that offer is unavailable. Do not conjure preservatives or bill a second self-treatment charge for the same operation. Material freshness, access, volume, containment and original clocks still matter. Resurrection requires an actual available operative effect and finite contract; a service-price row cannot author a missing resurrection procedure.

Ordinary license administration takes one active hour with the actual desk, applicant and evidence. Before work the offer must state its posted fee, qualification, jurisdiction, scope and expiry; the source supplied no universal fee. Routine satisfied requirements issue without a roll. Uncertain evidence/persuasion uses its own procedure, and success grants nothing beyond the official's authority.

Patronage and information use the actual social-scene time/stakes and venue quote. A Core rumor-network fee grants its printed advantage only to real relevant Gather Information work using the appropriate existing skill; it creates no new proficiency. A private meeting protects only against the ordinary surveillance measures actually provided. Faction's 24-hour reporting checkpoints do not add labor or free service hours.

exactEvidenceLocationsRead.excerpt:
Plain accessible speech or text in a known language needs no comprehension roll. That does not establish its truth, solve a code, authenticate it, reveal technical context or recover missing facts. Remembering a specific message understood through temporary magic preserves that information after the effect ends; general competence does not persist.

| Task | Procedure | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Copy visible characters | Actual access, tools, stock and time | A facsimile; no certified meaning or magical encoding |
| **NEW** ordinary prose translation | Source reading and destination writing; ten active minutes per 250 words, proportionately rounded up to a minute, minimum one | Plain noncoded prose in the destination language; no roll merely for translation |
| **NEW** uncertain recognition | One minute; normally INT/History, DC 10 familiar attested style, 15 supported related form, 20 damaged but diagnostic evidence | Supported identity or relationship; no translation |
| **NEW** Translate/Decipher project | One preregistered supported passage of at most 250 words; eight active hours; declared evidence, method, output and DC | Only the supported passage or cipher layer |

Routine obvious recognition needs no roll. A nondiagnostic specimen cannot reveal its identity through a high roll. Translation speed does not replace formula-copying, magical encoding or contract-authentication procedures.

For the eight-hour project, register the actual source meaning or finite supported meaning, relevant parallel/grammatical/key evidence and missing sections before work. Linguistic reconstruction uses INT/History: DC 15 supported related dialect, 20 unfamiliar but adequately evidenced language, 25 damaged yet recoverable correspondence. A separate mundane cipher uses INT/Investigation: DC 15 adequate known key, 20 constrained ordinary analysis, 25 difficult but genuinely solvable damaged/incomplete key. A plainly usable key may remove uncertainty; it does not provide a missing underlying language.

Declare one lead and one applicable PB contribution. **NEW project-specific assistance:** one qualified assistant contributes +1 after all eight hours of actually useful participation. This does not add assistants to other procedures. Apply the existing Core task degrees and natural shifts.

Success supplies only the registered supported result. Critical Success grants no second passage, fluency, extra meaning, code bypass or banked labor. Failure leaves notes and spent work, without a certified translation. Critical Failure has the same informational result plus only a genuinely predeclared, independently lawful hazard. No failure fabricates authoritative lore. An inaccessible or unsupported meaning makes the project unqualified before work; a destroyed gap stays a gap.

A fresh attempt requires genuinely new evidence or a concretely different supported method, and fresh required work. Changing readers, dates, copies or formatting alone does not create evidence or reset an unchanged failed attempt. Information genuinely discovered can support later work; past hours and rewards are never credited twice.

Formula research and copying retain their trade gates, DC, minimum research time and one-hour/1-sp copying rule. Scribing Insight uses its separate procedure below. A subject-limited background information feature is not general translation. Pending research/language feats give no current discount or bonus.

## Communicate in a scene
