exactEvidenceLocationsRead.excerpt:
## Learn a language

**NEW ordinary course:** choose one language/dialect and the modes sought. Identify the learner, the relevant script, legitimate access, and an actual qualified instructor or a complete usable curriculum. An instructor needs the modes taught and a mutually usable channel. Self-study needs authentic explanations, examples, exercises and a way to check their meaning. An unknown inscription, an isolated translation, money or an Insight balance is not a curriculum. Spoken practice needs actual production and correction; comprehension-only magic does not supply it.

| Module | Active work |
|---|---:|
| Spoken comprehension and production | 240 hours |
| Literacy after knowing the language's semantics | 80 hours |
| Script/orthography portion included in that literacy | 40 hours |
| Script familiarity alone, without semantics | 40 hours |

A complete new spoken-and-written language requires **320 active hours**, or **280** with genuine prior knowledge of that same script. Literacy for a semantically known language takes 80 hours, or 40 with that script already known. A written-only language uses 240 hours of written semantics plus the 80-hour literacy module and grants only its attested written modes. Related dialects give no automatic discount. An explicit grant bypasses study only for the modes it actually grants; valid starting knowledge incurs no retroactive fee.

Credit complete **15-active-minute phases**. Interruption loses the unfinished phase's prospective credit; previous credit survives, while real time, materials and fees remain spent. A shorter final phase is allowed only to finish the exact module after a real source-specific adjustment. Missing instruction, access or a usable channel yields no progress. Log real losses separately. Administrative phases do not break actual concentration or evade Oracle Tongues' actual save and ten-minute loss.

**NEW tuition reference:** 1 gp per eight actual instruction hours, including ordinary lesson consumables the provider actually supplies. A real quote or voluntary teacher may differ. Self-study has no invented tutor fee but needs actual materials. Pay for actual instruction time, including time an interruption made unproductive. Round each actual final purchase once upward to copper; do not round every phase separately. Prepaid time and refunds follow the actual agreement. A price does not conjure a teacher, rare text, permission or equipment.

Use actual time within eight-hour Watches and the two-active-work-Watch ceiling, with governing rest, Strain and access limits. The tutor is occupied too. A minute cannot also fund guarding, travel, beneficial rest, crafting, research, another course, gaining Insight or spending Insight without an explicit rule allowing that concurrency. No calendar-day shortcut, INT/PB discount or pending feat applies.

Completion is deterministic after genuine required work and authentic final practice, included in the last required phase. There is no random final fluency roll, added examination period or completion fee. Record the acquired modes and their source. Gain no XP, PB, Expertise, formula, spell, rank, faction permission or another language. Partial study can establish particular recorded words; it does not satisfy a requirement to know the language.

**Example:** an Orcish-literate learner studies Gnomish with a qualified teacher and usable lessons. Shared Dwarvish script reduces the course to 280 hours, reference tuition 35 gp. A 40-minute lesson interrupted during its third phase gives 30 credited minutes but consumes 40 actual minutes; one invoice at the reference rate costs 9 cp. An applicable Tongues failure later removing ten credited minutes remains a real loss.

Actor-specific verbal restrictions and a physical sound-suppression field differ. Neither automatically grants thunder immunity. Silence does not automatically end otherwise legal nonauditory concentration; a particular sustained audible performance may have stricter rules.

## Actual spell and ancestry interfaces

The [spell procedures](SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md) and [ancestry supplement](ANCESTRY_SPELL_SUPPLEMENT_PLAYTEST.md) remain controlling. The accompanying public language data contains the eight actual operative spell records without altering their access or status.

| Effect | Language boundary |
|---|---|
| Comprehend Languages | Action V/S/F, Self, concentration up to ten minutes; speech actually heard and writing clearly seen or touched within 30 ft. Literal understanding only; no speaking/writing proficiency, cipher/secret-cant/protected-meaning bypass, glyph function, command words, untranslatable proper names or nonliteral cultural subtext. |
| Message | Action V/S, perceived recipient within 120 ft under its actual line/cover rules, one message fitting the Action. No automatic reply, translation, authentication, mind-reading, planar contact or total-cover bypass; no imported 25-word limit. |
| Speak with Dead | Actual 60-ft remains/line-of-effect procedure; Action V/S/F; up to one minute/five exchanges, no concentration. Casting asks no question. Each unified inquiry/answer costs its own Action/about six seconds and an allowance, even if unknown or uncomprehended. The echo uses a language known to the deceased and its memories/beliefs, not omniscient truth. Preserve its original expiration marker through initiative changes. |
| Omen Whisper | One actually supported clue perceived and understood by the caster, under its subject/repetition limits; no new language or identified speaker. |
| Calm Whispers | Actual hearing target and failed-save rider; no added shared-language gate. |
| Resonance Whisper | Actual Guide/Disturb task riders and duration; no communication proficiency. |
| Soundburst | Actual damage/save and native Deafened duration; no invented universal alarm radius. |
| Silent Image | Static visual illusion without sound; depicted writing is not automatically true translation, authentic evidence or functional magic. |

Cavern Mystic's fungi-only WIS Speak with Plants begins at character level 1 and is one/long rest: Action V/S, ten minutes, no concentration, local plants within 30 ft, supported simple impressions from the prior 24 hours. It gives no network, control or unknown answer. Shaman Orc's WIS Speak with Animals begins at character level 3 and remains **one/day**: Action V/S, ten minutes, no concentration, actual hearing Beasts in auditory range, basic ideas within their experience and intelligence, with normal agency. These actual innate routes do not create ordinary class/RP access. Arcanist Gnome communicates basic ideas through its actual sounds-and-gestures method with Small-or-smaller beasts; required physical channels remain required.

## Names, dialects and modes

Record spoken comprehension, speaking, reading, writing and script familiarity separately. Knowledge and current ability to use it are different: deafness may stop you hearing a language you know; it does not remove that knowledge.

**NEW permanent-grant convention:** a permanent ordinary grant saying “know,” “one language,” or a background language row grants spoken comprehension, speaking, reading and writing in the language's attested ordinary written form, unless expressly narrowed. Temporary understanding, basic ideas, fragmentary writing and magical communication give only their specific modes or meaning.

Orc and Orcish are one identity; Mycelic and Sporetongue are one. **NEW chosen interpretation of the book's option:** Imperial's Westreach, Eastern Sigil and Northern Vale use Common mechanically, while retaining their cultural/register labels. They do not consume extra choices or decode ciphers. “Mycelian” is an ancestry/legacy label, not an alias for Mycelic.

Trollish and Giant remain distinct. Deep Cant, Deep Speech, Murkish, Forgotten Script, Runic and Resonant Cant remain distinct. Shared letters, an ancient description or a similar name does not establish mutual comprehension or permission to select an otherwise restricted language.

**NEW Primordial policy:** general Primordial and Auran, Aquan, Ignan and Terran are independently known, related competencies. Knowing one does not automatically grant any of the others. Elemental-Touched chooses general Primordial **or** the dialect matching its already selected affinity: air/Auran, water/Aquan, fire/Ignan, earth/Terran. This fills one grant. Its Aquan is the same language an Amphibian knows. Other sources granting Primordial give general Primordial unless they expressly offer a dialect choice.

Gnomish and Orcish use Dwarvish script. Knowing its letters does not teach either language's grammar, meaning or cultural context. Where no named script is given, record a language-local orthography without inventing a lore name. **NEW written-competency completion:** Runic grants its attested written content; Forgotten Script must identify the actual admitted written tradition. Unspecified spoken forms remain unspecified. Recognizing or copying characters alone does not understand them.

No grant creates anatomy, a pheromone emitter, hearing, sight, hands, writing implements or a magical channel. Mycelic's description does not supply an invented biological ability. An ordinary flat ink page is not tactile-readable merely because its reader knows the language; an actual touch-reading spell exception has its own scope.

The published names The Voice and Resonant Cant retain their existing restrictions; this chapter grants neither ordinary enrollment nor an automatic class entitlement. Their meanings and deeper relationships remain deferred. No hidden-language list is created here.

## Class features and Paladin oaths

Use each acquired feature's complete source card for acquisition and operation. The [selected language interfaces](../../data/playtest/language_communication_candidate_public.json) identify the applicable card IDs without granting them; the included [Paladin cards](../../data/public/class_playtests/paladin.json) supply the oath procedures. The other selected full class collections remain under `data/public/class_playtests/`, with Bard in `data/public/Decennium_Descent_Bard_Playtest_v0_1.json`. These language completions retain every card's existing status.

Druidic retains its actual hidden-message procedure: knowers notice/read the message; nonknowers can notice its presence at DC 15 without decoding it. **NEW**, permanent Druidic knowledge includes ordinary language modes. A plain sentence, hidden message and separate cipher remain different objects; translation magic still obeys its own exclusions. Form speech limits and actual Beast Spells/Archdruid exceptions are separate.

Oracle Tongues I grants receptive spoken-mortal comprehension, without speaking every language or universal literacy. Its interpretation bonus needs up to three actually hearing allies within 25 ft and a genuinely related check. **NEW “Lore” completion:** use one subject-appropriate existing knowledge skill, ordinarily INT/History for language/history; Arcana, Religion, Nature or Engineering applies only to its actual subject. No new proficiency, additional PB or Language Insight currency follows.

**NEW bounded meaning:** Tongues III's one question/answer, IV's meaningful exchange, V's one command and Heaven's Decree's selected instruction convey only the meaning needed by that specific lawful effect. Keep every speech activation, range, actual hearing requirement, save, target limit and refusal/agency restriction. Tongues III gains no hearing requirement absent from its card. Unknown answers remain unknown; NPC-save and player-refusal rules remain distinct. Dominion truth-restricting auras gain no translation bridge or compelled confession.

# Healing, survival and resurrection — playtest interface

**REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED — selected scope only.** The [final notebook review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_HEALING_FINAL_CLOSURE.md) closes147 classified class passages plus6 individually reviewed ordinary spell objects. Those6 spells are now operational playtest drafts; the catalog has78 operational and770 unfinished entries. This is a bounded interface, not DD24 completion:131 additional semantic matches and healing content in other domains still need dispositions. Original cards/books are preserved.

[Exact source procedures](HEALING_DEATH_SOURCE_BINDINGS.md) · [Latest boundary decisions](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_HEALING_FINAL_BOUNDARIES.md) · [Supplement decisions](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_HEALING_SUPPLEMENT_REVIEW.md) · [Reference checks](HEALING_PLAYTEST_VALIDATION.json) · [Source integrity](HEALING_DEATH_SOURCE_VALIDATION.json)

## Distinct life operations

| Operation | Result | Restriction interface |
|---|---|---|
| Minimum-HP prevention | Preserve positiveHP instead of crossing a floor | Not HP gain; cannot create positiveHP from0 |
| Ordinary healing | Increase a living creature's normalHP | Apply modifiers, prohibitions, reserve and Critical ceiling |
| Direct state recovery | Specifically defined dying/Stable/HP recovery | Broad cannot-regain-HP applies; ordinary healing modifiers do not |
| Would-die replacement | Replace a pending death before it becomes final | Exact source eligibility; not a generic damage floor |
| Resurrection | Actually dead willing identity returns at printedHP | Separate life transition; actual corpse/soul blockers apply |
| Companion reconstruction | Restore a device/companion through its own source | No general creature resurrection permission |
| TemporaryHP | Separate nonstacking buffer | Not healing, stabilization or resurrection |

Names never select the operation. Phoenix Rebirth heals a still-living ally at0. Cleric Resurrection returns an actual dead identity. Ritual of Undeath's Ward replaces death; ordinary Death Ward is a positive-to-zero floor. Feign death and spirit manifestations are not death or resurrection.

## Damage quantities and resolution

| Quantity | Definition and use |
|---|---|
| resolvedDamage | After defenses, before tempHP; positive damage event iff greater than0 |
| tempAbsorbed | min(tempHP, resolvedDamage) |
| postTempDamage | resolvedDamage minus tempAbsorbed, uncapped by currentHP; Core Instant Death/Wounds |
| actualHpDamage | NormalHP lost to the packet after true prevention; recovery and state-assignment loss excluded |
| actualDamageDealt | NEW anti-overkill bridge: tempAbsorbed plus actualHpDamage; numeric actual-damage drains/reflections |

Ordinary “damages,” “takes damage” and “damaging hit” predicates use a positive resolved packet. Actual-HP wording (Burning Blood/Rewind Wound) uses actualHpDamage. Numeric actual-damage wording (Sanguine Rite/Echo Leech/Merciful Smite/Wound Eater/Gravebrand) uses actualDamageDealt. Source attack/hit predicates remain distinct.

Example: HP10/temp10 takes5: numeric actual damage5, actualHP damage0, positive packet. HP1 under a floor takes5: numeric0 but positive packet. HP3 takes12: numeric3, raw post-temp12. HP0 takes1: numeric0, positive packet and normal death-failure consequences.

Divine Judgment consumes its once-this-actual-target-turn entitlement on a positive packet, then reflects min(Cleric level, max(1, floor(actualDamageDealt/2))). Thus HP1-floor/numeric0 reflects1 and consumes; fully prevented resolved0 does neither. Wrathful Brand/Balanced Scales use the positive predicate where their source says damage occurred.

Resolve a damage event in this order:

1. Snapshot pre-event HP/tempHP/Wounds; resolve defenses, temp absorption and uncapped post-temp damage.
2. Core Instant Death uses postTempDamage minus preHP greater than or equal to effective maximum when reduced to0. It precedes ordinary floors. Open a legal would-die replacement; stop that packet's death procedure. No Wound save or zero-HP failure follows this branch.
3. If not Instant Death, resolve applicable true floors. They cannot raise an already0 creature. They preserve raw damage and attached conditions; a prevented drop creates no drop-only Wound trigger, but half-max/Maiming still applies.
4. Spiral-TouchedIII alone has a specific pre-Wound recovery exception. If positive-to-zero remains, spend its use, preserve that raw crossing trigger, attempt quarter-max direct recovery and apply phase-out. Broad HP-gain prohibition blocks the recovery but not the use/phase.
5. Resolve the one Core Wound save using original post-temp damage and pre-event Wounds. Fatal Wound death opens its own legal replacement window. Actual death ends Spiral phase; a successful independent Ward prevents actual death.
6. Resolve already-zero damage failures/death and its legal replacement window. A successful replacement stops skipped same-packet death branches; never replay a Wound/failure branch merely because replacement changedHP.
7. Finalize a newly surviving0 creature's dying/Stable/knockout state. Only an explicitly triggered post-zero Reaction such as Grace Reversal can act before ordinary zeroHP Reaction loss finalizes.
8. Resolve eligible post-zero Phoenix/Unyielding-style healing only if target still lives, followed by later triggers. This healing never retroactively reduces the triggering packet's numeric damage.

The affected creature chooses among simultaneously eligible offered survival effects, then rechecks remaining triggers. A paid Reaction spends its declared cost; a limited automatic survival use spends when its actual source resolves. A true floor preventing the crossing means Spiral's use is not spent. No generic extra Reaction or return from death is created.

For Ritual Ward, sufficient body and no explicitly unpreventable death are prerequisites. It can intercept Instant Death, fatal Wounds, third death-save failure, eligible direct death and lethal tracks. Positive pre-eventHP→1 is loss prevention and works through Decay. Already0 with HP gain prohibited instead becomes living Stable0: clear counters and establish a d4-hour recovery deadline immediately.

Freeze packetHpLossBeforeReplacement after true floors but before Ward. Ward metrics are min(packetHpLossBeforeReplacement, max(0, preHP minus replacementHP)); never include loss caused solely by assigning a lowerHP state. HP20 takes10 then fatal Wound/Ward1 means actualHP damage10, not19. HP5 takes100 then Ward1 means actualHP damage4, raw100.

Direct death (e.g. Wound EaterIII) produces no damage or Wound save. Its healing requires actual death; a Ward interception prevents that trigger without refunding the paid activation. False LifeI has only its printed floor and failed-death-save replacement modes sharing1/LR; it is not an all-causes Ward.

## ZeroHP permissions and start timing

A conscious but dying creature still rolls at each regular start unless Stable. Extra turns do not advance these regular-start deadlines. Further damage and actual death retain normal consequences.

Mage Undying Spellform partially overrides only zeroHP Unconscious/Incapacitated restrictions: normal speech, voluntary half-Speed movement, normal Action, legal spellcasting with that Action, and starting/maintaining concentration. No independent BA/Reaction. Existing concentration avoids automatic loss from zeroHP, but the triggering damage still requires its concentration save. Separate Stunned/Unconscious/Expedition5 or6/Silence and other restrictions still apply. Healing above0 ends the feature. Expiry at0 destabilizes, cancels the Stable recovery deadline and adds one failure; the third kills normally and permits only an eligible would-die replacement.

Oracle False LifeIII permits exactly one choice during the allowed zeroHP turn: move up to Speed, speak, or activate one Revelation. The latter uses its printed Action/BA/trigger (trigger must occur on that turn), costs and components. It can start concentration; the feature did not preserve earlier concentration. No independent actions accompany the choice.

False LifeV quarter-max direct recovery resolves at its next regular start before the death save. Blocked recovery leaves0 without invented stability; dead creatures do not revive. Spiral phase expires at its next regular start before normal start processing. Fate-BoundIV rerolls a failed death save before committing natural1/counters; use the new result. Its generic death-effect save bonus is not an ordinary death-save modifier. A natural20 whose1HP is blocked uses the previously reviewed Decay bridge: Stable0, cleared counters, immediate d4-hour deadline and preserved used-turn marker. It does not spend Ward. This differs from blocked False LifeV, which remains dying.

## Ordinary healing arithmetic

Determine legal source, recipients, costs, clocks and available entitlements before arithmetic. The helper receives already eligible modifiers; it does not acquire class powers or validate every source for its caller.

Pre-resolution modifiers include Words of Equilibrium's formula M, Zealot's Fervor +S, Throne's Grace +1/die capped S+M, Benevolent Spirits' eligible paid-technique +M, Life Prophecy maximizing dice, and Crane's applicable +S. Conditional add-ons include Ground, Radiance, Aura of Faith, Ember Mantle, Life Linked's rolled1d4, Ranger Healing Touch, Aura of Mercy, Garden's stored+1 and Tranquil Lotus Step.

First compute without conditional add-ons. Only if this preview actually restores at least1HP, recompute that same event once with its eligible add-ons. The preview changes no pools/uses. Base5 minus5 plus a conditional3 remains0; eligible pre-resolution Benevolent3 yields3. Multiple flat class bonuses use the strongest across both passes unless an explicit source exception allows stacking. Rolled extra dice/per-die changes are separate.

Within each permitted reduction plan: formula/bonuses; per-die adjustments; compatible exact fractional multipliers with one floor after multiplication; compatible flat reductions; floor at0; broad HP prohibition; maximum/Critical/reserve caps. Intrinsic Wound Eater and systemic Corrupted remain independent factors. Duplicate same-stat per-die penalties use the strongest. Dice remain dice when maximized/shared; flat Lay on Hands and stored numeric Echoes have zero healing dice.

Blight Totem cannot compound other local healing reducers. Compare systemic factors plus Totem-half alone against systemic factors plus all otherwise compatible local reducers; use the lower result. Compatible halves multiply, compatible distinct flat penalties add, duplicate same-profile groups use strongest. Suppressed reducers do not participate.

Every present, operative, applicable next-positive-healing reduction consumes exactly once when the final event commits if its pre-reduction HP potential was positive. This includes reducers whose arithmetic branch lost to Totem or whose actual gain was later blocked. Zero potential and suppressed records consume none. Two-pass preview never consumes twice.

Critical at3Wounds caps ordinary healing at max(1, effective maximum minus1); it is not a maximumHP reduction and healing cannot lower currentHP. Reserve spends only actualHP restored. A final heal8 with room3 spends3 reserve; blocked healing spends0, other activation costs remain paid. Revival/form changes/encounter starts do not replenish reserve.

## Recovery gates, triggers and loops

False Life curse gates another creature's healing SPELL: optional Insight vs RevelationDC; success permits; failed or declined check rolls d2,1 blocks HP and2 permits. Nonspell recovery and independent nonHP components remain distinct. Burning Blood blocks the cold-tagged HP-healing component only, not independent tempHP/stabilization/resurrection.

Actual positiveHP restoration is required for Radiance's cure, Renewal's Stamina, Sanctified Reprisal and Life Prophecy's RC trigger. Meditative Healing's laterKi and Transcendent Meditation's second-pulseKi are independent components and still resolve when healing caps/blocks. Blood Tithe uses its actual qualifying hostile Bleed-death trigger and finite use; not staged farming.

Passive regeneration includes Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer's modification; these retain Reserve. Finite paid/limited pulses such as Aura of Grace, Living Pulse, Renewal Totem, Blood Feast, Exsanguinate, Hemostasis, Transcendent Meditation, Cellular Reconstruction and Adrenal Floodgate are not passive regeneration. Their own Downed/Incapacitated gates remain. A passive-regeneration prohibition is not a universal healing prohibition.

Lay on Hands retains its5×Paladin-level finite pool and ordinary Long Rest refill. Base Action spends at most level on one target; Hero1/LR spends the entire remaining pool across at most3, each allocation at least1. No RP conversion. Verdict Absolute's explicit qualifying brand-kill refill is a source exception. **Remainder-conference amendment — engine[13] cadence reconciliation:** level17 Wave is1/long rest, superseding the preserved Hero card and earlier guide's1/short-rest wording. This follows the explicit engine reconciliation; the old source remains intact. Wider pool/recharge execution still belongs to the resource pass.

Transfusion donor spends K normalHP; recipient ordinary base is K+floor(K/2). Channel Life spends X; baseX. Donor must remain at least1, tempHP cannot pay, loss is not damage and cannot be prevented/redirected/refunded when recipient gets0. Recipient legal bonuses/reductions apply.

Secondary healing retains root ID and visited application IDs in a shared causal ledger, including across sibling branches. Each link/application can fire at most once/root. Numeric add-ons remain the same packet, creating no new root/child. Legal finite primary healing may trigger unrelated eligible effects.

Stronger source flags override generic provenance: Vitality Link's child blocks every further link; Echo Leech blocks secondary healing/resource triggers; Blood Feast blocks damage/resource triggers; Merciful Smite blocks Smite/heal-copy chains; Crown Undying blocks redirection/heal-copy chains; Echoes/Spiral copies retain their explicit exclusions. Source payment and direct/actual-gain predicates still apply before a child exists.

## Excess healing

OrdinaryMissingHP = effective maximum minus currentHP. Genuine excess is max(0, legal post-reduction healing minus OrdinaryMissingHP). Broad HP prohibition makes legal healing and excess0. Critical's ceiling does not redefine missingHP: max20/HP19/Critical/legalheal10 restores0 but has9 genuine excess; the missing1 is not excess. At HP20, legalheal10 has10 excess.

This quantity alone grants no conversion. A legal converter must satisfy its own costs/caps/cadences. One excess point can fund only one conversion. Source-internal Overflowing Light resolves before outside Cosmic Equilibrium uses remaining excess. Channel Life attaches a packet-wide prohibition on ALL excess-to-tempHP conversion, including another owner's feature. It permits an otherwise eligible Cosmic damage conversion.

**NEW agreed source exclusion:** Unpaid passive regeneration bounded by Mutation Recovery Reserve cannot supply excess-healing conversions unless a future source explicitly grants an exception. This covers Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer as a Bloodthick modifier. FullHP/Critical may compute mathematical excess but grants no Cosmic conversion and spends no Reserve. Do not extend this exclusion to otherwise eligible paid/finite healing merely because it restores0HP.

## Actual resurrection and retained consequences

Require an actually dead, willing identity, legal source body/anchor, location, target limit, elapsed window, paid cost and no applicable resurrection/soul blocker. ReturnedHP is a life transition, unaffected by ordinary healing multipliers or generic living HP-gain prohibitions. Explicit corpse-local and identity/soul blockers are different scopes.

Preserve Wounds/Injuries, Corruption, intrinsic Oracle Curse, debt/legal-death/body claims and spent resources. ThreeWounds is Critical, not continuous automatic death. Clear death counters/Stable deadline but preserve used turn markers and persistent histories. No duplicate creature or resource refresh.

| Class source | Exact selected procedure |
|---|---|
| Cleric Resurrection | Touch one eligible allied body, dead≤60seconds;1HP and printed2S+M tempHP1minute;3Conviction+10RP;1/LR |
| Celestial Resurgence | Up to6 eligible allied corpses30ft, dead≤18elapsedseconds;1HP;5Conviction+10RP;1/LR |
| Divine Rebirth | One successful resurrection by your Cleric feature instead max(1,floor(effectiveMax/2))HP plus printedS+M tempHP1minute;1/LR |
| Thousand Petals | At most6total including at most2eligible corpses20ft;5Ki+5RP;1/LR. Living3S d8+M healing, dead1HP. Corpse died strictly after previous source regular end. Printed floor until next source start |
| Grace Reversal | Source Reaction on surviving positive→0;10RP;one other eligible allied corpse in Oath aura since previous source regular end; Paladin stays0 |
| Soulbound Ritual / Snap Rebuild | Companion/device reconstruction via exact token/slot/expiry restrictions; no generic creature revival |

Thousand Petals revival history is campaign-persistent per Monk-owner/target identity; another Monk/source remains independent. Grace Reversal history is per Paladin-owner/target until that Paladin's qualifying Long Rest. Death of either participant resets neither. Living healing does not spend resurrection history.

Elapsed windows are inclusive (exact60seconds qualifies); previous-end windows are strictly after that typed phase20 marker through the current event. Initiative changes do not rewrite history.

## Lethal tracks after return or replacement

Both an actual resurrection and would-die replacement retain lethal tracks. Exhaustion6 becomes protected exhaustion.lethal-collapse: alive, Unconscious, no voluntary act/travel. Its static lethal endpoint is suspended for this protected return, ending once legally below6. A qualifying Long Rest can occur unconscious with another creature's care/food/water, inactive root cause and no recovery blocker.

Expedition6 retains all six provenance-bearing points and enters its existing collapse. Only genuine24hour Haven care or explicit eligible treatment can reduce it; point removal gates persist. A later positive unprevented gain at6 reevaluates either track's lethal endpoint. A fresh independently legal finite Ward may intervene; collapse is not continuing immunity.

## Removing suppressed Bleed and fire

Cures examine present, unexpired, not-ended records, including temporary suppression/acquired immunity. Initial immunity that prevented application leaves nothing to cure. Damage arbitration and active hooks still exclude suppressed/immune records.

Medicine selects one present eligible Bleed before rolling its printed/source/fallbackDC. A legal positive-potential magical heal invokes every present applicable Bleed endpoint; each Blood Curse instead receives its printedCON save. An actualHP-gain prerequisite still controls a source that expressly requires it.

A legal extinguish Action/full immersion ends all present ordinary-extinguishable fires within its scope; protected/special prerequisite fires persist. A permitted per-record fire DEX ending save remains available while suppressed when a future tick remains; no extra save after the final consumed tick. Cured records never resume when suppression ends.

## Six ordinary spells — reviewed operational playtest drafts

All retain preserved Action/RP/rank/class gates, and range120ft except Ward60ft. V/S/F uses the established M/F focus alternative; no imported material cost.

| Spell | Proposed individual operation |
|---|---|
| Stitch Fate | Rank8/21RP. Living dying0, not Stable/dead. Remove one recorded failure, or direct1HP recovery/clear counters; blocked latter becomes Stable0 with immediate d4-hour deadline. Not retrospective death undo |

Soul Bind removal targets pending creature or existing post-death remains as local anchor. With no remains, removal must expressly free the bound identity/soul; invent no physical anchor. No mind control, ownership or indefinite prison. True Resurrection still obeys actual identity/soul barriers, and an already-living identity is ineligible. Complete objects retain countering, Dissonance/Refrain, costs and source access.

## Temporal dependency and validation boundary

Spiral-TouchedV Time Loop is temporal restoration, not generic resurrection. Its discussed participant contract restores recorded position, life/death/HP/temp/counters, Wounds/linked Injuries, Core/custom conditions, RC, per-encounter uses and snapshot Soul Bind state. Post-snapshot death/body destruction is conceptually undone; already-dead-at-snapshot remains dead. Generic corpse-resurrection denial does not automatically block it.

It does not restore RP/Ki/Conviction/BG, device resources, Mutation Reserve, daily/rest uses, physical consumables or its own spent use. The helper tests that field distinction only. Full equipment/environment topology, corpse/body-part duplication and clock rebasing remain in the dedicated temporal package; Time Loop is not declared fully operational by these tests.

Current selected checks:164 healing/death plus120 unchanged Core damage states;150 control including2 new clarification cases;98 custom including14 cure-presence cases;153 exact source records. These are interface tests, not execution of147 complete class cards, numerical balance, whole-game completion or a substitute for human playtesting.

The Choir observed with awe. Here existed beings neither devil nor angel, neither demon nor Choir. Their choices might tip balances with astonishing efficiency because they lacked predetermined bias. Calan’thir proposed gift: grant mortals subtle attunement pathways so they could draw inspiration from planes without losing agency. Transition opened faint channels, guiding dreamers into Radiant archipelagos, guiding philosophers toward Thought constellations, guiding adventurers into Crucible chambers. Asmodeus also observed. Mortal souls represented fresh currency. Seeds of infernal law could flourish in hearts eager for certainty. He tasked contracts wraiths to wander dreamscapes, offering hope in exchange for vow. Thus conflict extended downward, but under Choir surveillance coercion remained limited. The stage set for ages of guided free will. When all dust settled, the Divine Pact pulsed with deeper timbre. Fire, shadow, dream, and thought now sang four part counterpoint around seal. Their endless discourse radiated energies that lulled Ul’nak to deeper slumber while feeding Spiral motion. The Choir maintained vigilant harmony. Asmodeus directed infernal war from afar. Demons beat drums of unending revolt. Mortals awoke to skies colored by unseen planes.

Yet every new branch increased complexity, presenting gaps through which hush might seep. To address risk, Pattern drafted great schema linking all plane frequencies into overarching cadence. Courage and Sorrow acted as pillars anchoring farthest extremes, while Contradiction wove tolerance for paradox into central hub. Law sealed plan with charter recognized by Pact yet free of Asmodeus seal. This grand map would guide future calibrations. While grand realms found shape, fragments of Source energy near prison coalesced into first mortal souls on world called Aethel. These souls shimmered fragile, ignorant of cosmic war, yet their resonance chimed perfectly with newborn planes. A child’s fearless laughter resonated with Courage pillar in Bastion. An elder’s whispered regret drifted through Sorrow’s gardens in Veiled Expanse. A scholar’s restless curiosity soared across Boundless Void.

The beliefs recorded in this appendix are mortal theology, not objective cosmic history. Priests, scholars, and cults across Aethel have spent millennia reasoning about forces they cannot fully perceive. What follows is what the faithful believe: a creation myth, a pantheon of worshiped faces, and a diagram of the planes — sincerely held, widely taught, and useful for understanding how ordinary people in Aethel think about the divine. Your character may treat this as literal truth. Deeper mysteries of the Spiral and the Crucible may surface only through play; even then, the wider world does not rewrite its temples overnight. Scholars may also speak of the First Choir — seven named virtues (Korvelan, Vaerilune, Delvaran, Shaelara, Xalarex, Thalirion, and Virellian) — as part of the wider Spiral story. That knowledge is not secret, but it is not tavern talk either.

Place one clue in the environment, one in an NPC or rival relationship, one in a recoverable record, and one in the behavior of the tier’s hazards. The Expedition should be able to assemble the truth from different team contributions. This is where the twelve-seat structure earns its place: Combat may hold the approach, Reconnaissance finds the seam, Research reads the sequence, Resource prepares the material, and Support keeps the ritual intact.
The Dungeon beneath Aethel continues to birth chambers. Game masters roll on the Chamber Seed Table when the party descends to an undocumented floor.

## Corrupted

Use the condition's half healing, individually recorded Evil-source save disadvantage, aura and DC 15 WIS long-rest save. A failed long-rest save shifts the moral axis Good → Neutral → Evil without changing law/chaos. Never infer Evil from ancestry, species, faction, homeland or appearance. This label change does not compel beliefs, behavior, PvP, party separation or automatic oathbreaking. Specific conduct clauses still judge actual conduct.

**NEW generic cleansing:** One practitioner spends eight uninterrupted hours with one patient in a secure location, consumes one Supply at start, and makes INT (Religion) or INT (Arcana) against DC 15 at completion. Success removes Corrupted. Failure leaves it without any extra automatic Wound, condition or Exposure. No more than one generic attempt may complete for that patient in 24 elapsed hours; practitioners cannot stack concurrent attempts. The practitioner is working, while the patient may rest if otherwise eligible. If cleansing and the patient's long rest complete together, resolve cleansing first; make the Corrupted rest save only if it remains. A specific reviewed cleansing spell/item uses its own costs and procedure.

Guaranteed one-HP recovery from a natural-20 death save or the Stable recovery clock remains one HP: these are state-recovery rules, not healing effects. Ordinary one-point magical healing can still be halved to zero. It nevertheless ends generic Bleeding if it had positive pre-reduction healing potential.

## Unity Exposure — public provisional track

The source defines a 0–6 track with erosion of distinction and identity but no operational numeric threshold table was found in the bounded Core/V6/Director and current reference searches. GPT also reported no owner-approved numerical table in its available notebook history. The following is **NEW candidate mechanics**, not recovered setting truth. It grants no public knowledge of the exposure's hidden causes or identities.

Use the current row only; do not add lower-row modifiers.

| Score | Mechanical effect |
|---|---|
| 0 | No effect. |
| 1 | Tracked, without a generic numerical penalty. |
| 2 | −1 Perception/Investigation checks specifically distinguishing similar identities, copies, duplicates or conflicting sensory impressions. Declare this scope before rolling. |
| 3 | −1 INT and WIS ability checks. |
| 4 | −1 INT, WIS and CHA ability checks. |
| 5 | Disadvantage on INT, WIS and CHA ability checks. |
| 6 | Disadvantage on INT, WIS and CHA ability checks and saves. The character remains playable with player agency. |

Record changes only from explicit reviewed effects; cap at 0–6. These mechanics never decide a character's beliefs, loves, loyalty, factual memories, conduct or hidden revelations. A player can portray blurred memories or identity pressure without surrendering character control.

**NEW Anchor Project:** In a secure Haven or equivalent safe location, complete three full consecutive project days. Each day the patient spends two hours affirming chosen memories, relationships or personal distinctions and consumes one Supply. The player chooses the content. At the end of the third full day, make a WIS save against DC `10 + current Exposure`, including the track's actual penalties. Success reduces Exposure by one; failure does not. A new reduction requires a new full project. Ordinary rest does not reduce Exposure.

Any successful positive Exposure-gain event during the attempt interrupts it, including a gain capped at 6; prevented gains do not. Already consumed Supply remains spent. Only one Anchor Project per patient can be active. Specific reviewed removal effects may work differently. Director context and later source reconciliation remain separately packaged; private narrative information does not silently add numerical penalties or erase player agency.

# Part IV — Research Clocks

Research teams translate, identify, and map. Long discoveries use **clocks** — six ticks by default. One meaningful period of focused Research advances **one tick** on success (DC set by tier, typically 12 + tier).

## Player-facing clocks (safe to show)

| Clock | Facets (example) | Player-visible reward |
|-------|------------------|------------------------|
| **Warded Gate runes** | Sun · Binding · Silence · Threshold | Opens F4 without backlash |
| **Spore-Veil timing** | Read · Breathe · Cross | Safe Falls transit |
| **Sunforged Obelisk rings** | Dawn · Zenith · Prism | Hidden grotto |
| **Canticle Gate notes** | Four precise tones | Tier 5 gate |
| **Heartroot Surveyor's Seal** | Identify · Authenticate · File | Academic rep + legal claim |

Show players a progress bar or checklist. **Do not** label secret layers.

## Director-only stratum (never player-facing)

Some research touches machinery older than public myth. Use a **hidden track** parallel to player clocks.

| Player tick | What they think they learned | Director secret (examples) |
|-------------|------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Gate rune 3/6 | "Silence ward reduces echo" | Pattern matches pre-Pact masonry |
| Seal authenticated | "Surveyor had legal authority" | Seal geometry recurs on deeper floors |
| Obelisk aligned | "Light opens grotto" | Refraction angle implies **ten** divisions, not nine |
| Choir reliquary | "Sound calms wardens" | Resonance frequency matches bait architecture |

**Heartcell clues without spoiling:** reward Researchers with **actionable delver benefits** (advantage on next gate, identify loot) while you privately note **custodian vs architect** tension. Never say "Heartcell" or "Silent Ones" at the table unless players earn that name through deep-tier play.

**Runes and seals:** Rune Carving can assist Research — advantage if carver participates. Failed seal authentication may still advance the clock with a **complication** (forged copy, rival claim).

## Research clock complications (1d6 on failure or natural 1)

| d6 | Complication |
|----|--------------|
| 1 | Rival publishes first — lose rep race |
| 2 | Cursed text — Sorrow save or nightmares |
| 3 | False lead — next tick needs Scene to undo |
| 4 | Attracts warden attention |
| 5 | Academic patron demands exclusive rights |
| 6 | Breakthrough — free tick but collateral damage |

Ordinary spell research can be completed with Arcana and a laboratory. Matrix research cannot. The primary researcher must personally possess high ranks in multiple disciplines—Arcana, History, Religion, Nature, and Engineering—and must cross-reference rare drops, libraries, mechanisms, and seasonal changes. Archive knowledge may be inherited; cognitive continuity usually cannot.

## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. Fractions round down unless a rule specifies otherwise. One tile is 5 feet. Class L, S and effect M retain their definitions in the shared class rules.

**Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. In this overlay, a natural result below 20 in that range must still meet AC unless the feature expressly says it always hits.

**Task, skill or tool check against a fixed DC:** total at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC-10 is Critical Failure; other totals below DC are Failure. Natural 20 then improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one, bounded at either end. A task printing only success/failure collapses the two upper degrees to success and two lower degrees to failure; no extra consequence is invented. A natural 20 can still fail an otherwise impossible check, and a natural 1 with sufficient modifiers can still succeed.

**Saving throw:** total at least DC succeeds; otherwise it fails. Natural 1 and 20 have no generic special outcome. A printed failure by 5 or 10 compares the final total with the DC; it does not add an unprinted critical-save system. Death saves are the specific exception below.

**Opposed check, new provisional tie rule:** compare final totals. Higher wins; an exact tie leaves the existing state unchanged, so the initiating creature fails to change it. Do not turn task natural shifts into hidden numeric modifiers. A maneuver explicitly printing degree outcomes must specify how those apply.

value.title: Members, teams and offices
value.text:
An Expedition has at most **12 member characters**, including recruited NPCs and hirelings assigned independent Expedition jobs. Small Expeditions can use fewer teams and undertake feasible solo tasks. The following sizes are recommendations, not entry requirements.

| Team | Suggested members | Work |
|---|---:|---|
| Combat | 4–6 | Threats, battles and immediate protection |
| Reconnaissance | 1–3 | Scouting and mapping |
| Research | 1–3 | Study and identification |
| Resource | 2–4 | Gathering, crafting and harvesting |
| Support | 1–3 | Camp, care, repair and transport |

Appoint the five source offices: **Expedition Leader**, **Quartermaster**, **Routekeeper**, **Surgeon**, and **Claimant of Record**. The Leader represents the company and records tied organizational decisions; the Quartermaster tracks provisions, Load, cargo priority, wages and losses; the Routekeeper maintains the map; the Surgeon directs Wound treatment and casualty transport; the Claimant of Record maintains provenance, contracts and ownership documents. One person can hold several offices. An office grants no skill, extra Action or power over another player's consent or another owner's property.

Before work, record each member's primary activity or Rest, location, intended result, lead and assistants, and actual start/end times. Short tasks may follow one another. A person cannot perform incompatible activities during the same seconds. For a generic expedition task, up to three trained assistants who provide meaningful help each add +1. Exact crafting, harvesting, preservation, social and companion procedures use their own assistance rules instead.

Porters, bearers, guards and drivers contracted as members occupy roster seats. A public ship or caravan's external crew stays on its own service record and is not additional party labor or automatic combat support. Animals and source-bound noncharacter companions/devices do not occupy character seats; an intelligent creature recruited as an autonomous expedition character does. Larger forces use distinct cooperating Expeditions with real communication, shared finite resources and the same world clock.

# Time Loop: reviewed foundational transaction kernel

**Status: REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED within the bounded foundational scope. Full Time Loop remains unavailable.**

**Current-file qualification:** the original approval binds helper hash `b821829ed352e69ce1ecf3c3d753f0206c8f8d2ec5a5d64bc89d5fd7d8a72151`, preserved as `docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/temporal_playtest_rules_reviewed_foundation.py` at the game root. The current helper adds a control/pulse transaction adapter and regular-start phase tracking. Those extensions are now covered by the separate [bounded control/pulse review manifest](TEMPORAL_CONTROL_WORLD_REVIEW_STATUS.json), following actual notebook confirmation. They do not inherit the historical approval. The 76 foundation regressions still pass. See [integration progress](TEMPORAL_CONTROL_PLAYTEST.md).

This implements a bounded part of `oracle.supplement.spiral-touched.spiral-touched-boon-v`. It does not change the original source, enable the ability in the playable class catalog, or close the full temporal interface. The notebook's twelve decisions are the authority for this candidate: [boundary conference](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_TEMPORAL_WORLD_BOUNDARIES.md).

## What is implemented

The reference restores an immutable initiative-start snapshot through a preflighted transaction. It handles a finite development scene containing canonical Core life states, action wallets, selected feat shields, a temporal healing-consumption ledger, explicit Soul Bind/death identities, physical provenance, finite level-ground geometry, reward opportunities, external dependency records and character memory. The existing shared `LifeState`, `Wallet` and `BufferLedger` objects retain their identities. Spent resources and historical event records remain current.

The restore is permitted only after a complete atomic combat event, before round four, with an available Reaction and an unspent actual long-rest use. It never interrupts a damage, healing or command transaction. Preflight checks all registered state, source policies, physical dependencies and placements before charging anything. A prepared plan becomes stale if the registered world changes before commit. The single-thread reference requires the host scene lock through preflight and commit. Each committed restore also retains an engine/Director audit frame with the previous and resulting field values; that audit is never a source of character memory. The existing canonical BufferLedger completed-rest epoch also governs Time Loop's own long-rest use; there is no independent rest counter to diverge.

At commit, encounter initiative and the snapshot's Action/Bonus Action/Reaction allowances, RC and declared per-encounter uses return. Every outstanding Oracle Time Loop Reaction debt overlays the restored budgets. Only the owner's actual normal regular-start refresh clears that owner's debt. The public `TemporalKernel.regular_start(actor, now)` obtains the actor's canonical Wallet internally; it accepts no Wallet argument and rejects actor aliases sharing one Wallet. The bounded scheduler enforces the next actor at the initiative cursor, allows one active regular turn, and advances the cursor/round only when that exact turn ends. An out-of-order or repeated start cannot refresh a Reaction or advance the actual regular marker. Genuine extra turns require the later source adapter and cannot be represented as regular starts. The new iteration has fresh round/turn identities; the rewind itself creates no turn start, pulse or recharge tick. Elapsed world time, real regular-marker count, RP and finite-use history remain unchanged.

## Conservation checks

| State | Bounded behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Core HP and Wounds | Restore numeric snapshot HP against the current legal maximum. A lower maximum clamps HP without damage or healing; a higher maximum does not increase snapshot HP. Critical Wound healing ceilings do not limit temporal assignment. |
| Maximum HP | Use the existing maximum-HP calculation and an exact source-ID temporal policy table. The three reviewed Monk trauma IDs may restore except after actual rest ending. Tough, Tough as Nails, Tenacity and Dark Fortitude use current permanent progression records; temporary endpoints on those passive records are rejected. Other sources, including valid ordinary max-HP sources whose temporal/lifecycle adapter is absent, reject this fixture. Current supported external records overlay the result. Structural progression changes reject without a dedicated adapter. The host supplies current legal base/stat values. |
| Stable recovery | Preserve its original world deadline and event identity. An already resolved or expired recovery cannot replay; this kernel rejects such restoration rather than inventing a recovery rule. |
| Temporary HP | Restore the same grant ID and original snapshot amount only while its source's deadline/rest epoch/entity dependency remains valid. Supported IDs are Chef, Inspiring Leader, Field Medic, Soul Cage, Empowered Summoning and Blood Ritual. Required canonical ledger fields, unique grant IDs, active target/state and positive remaining amount are validated. Unknown sources and linked riders reject the scene. |
| One-shot healing reduction | Keep canonical effect ID and all past events. Consumption keys include the iteration. Snapshot-available Agony can be available in a new iteration before its original expiry; snapshot-consumed or expired Agony remains unavailable. |
| Soul Bind | Original absolute deadline, exact death instance for bound-dead records. An active pending record requires a living, non-Stable, dying zero-HP target with no death-instance binding. Application and target identities must match. Undoing a later death removes that later active bind. No revival event or source cost is manufactured. |
| Rewards | A claim belongs to encounter origin, immutable reward source, opportunity kind and source-defined slot. Another death event or iteration cannot make another claim. |
| Physical derivatives | Traverse immutable provenance transitively. A wholly in-scope, reversible temporal entity can retire; its costs stay spent. Surviving harvested inventory, mixed material roots, external source slots or persistent enrollment conflicts block the restore. Already consumed material remains consumed. |
| Outsiders | Keep body state, inventory ownership, resource history and concentration records. A snapshot dependency must still exist exactly and refer to the same live concentration ID. New current dependencies targeting restored participants need a supported overlay; otherwise they block. Unimplemented external anatomy/control/suppression overlays also block. |
| Environment | Each anchor has an exact canonical physical identity. Restore snapshot environment existence together with its geometry; remove both the physical derivative and its geometry when retiring a later temporal entity. Plan all participant positions simultaneously. Reject overlap, loss of support, and restrictions to a protected outsider's previously reachable ground area. This is deliberately limited to a finite orthogonal level ground plane, not flying, elevation, portals or mandatory growth. |
| Memory | The invoking Oracle and their immutable snapshot allies retain only facts individually perceived, experienced or received. Retained memories accumulate across loops. Enemy player characters receive no special knowledge; no hidden roster or Director facts enter memory automatically. |

## What the agreed rules mean at the table

These examples explain the reviewed boundaries. They do not enable the full ability before its remaining integrations are complete.

| Situation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| At initiative, an ally has25HP. Later they fall to3HP and spend8RP. Time Loop succeeds. | They return to25HP, limited by their current legal maximum. The8RP remain spent. Their snapshot encounter allowances return where the source explicitly permits it. |
| The same ally's legal maximum has fallen to20 because a conserved source changed. | They return to20HP. The reduction is temporal normalization, not damage or healing, and creates neither Wounds nor resource triggers. A structural progression change without its adapter instead makes the restore unavailable. |
| An ally began with a6-point Soul Cage shield, later lost it, and the original grant remains valid. | The same shield returns with its snapshot6 points. The Soul Charge paid for it remains spent. This is not a new cast, grant or recipient offer. |
| Oracle A uses Time Loop. Before A's next actual regular turn, Oracle B uses it too. | Both Oracles retain their Reaction debts. Rewinding does not clear A's debt. Each debt clears only at that Oracle's genuine normal Reaction refresh. |
| A restored enemy dies again after its reward opportunity was already claimed. | That same reward cannot be claimed again. The source opportunity, rather than the new death event, determines whether it was paid. |
| A body part was harvested after initiative and still exists as somebody else's item. | The generic restore is unavailable: it cannot duplicate the body part or take away the current owner's item. A specifically reviewed reconciliation would be required. |
| An ally saw a hidden passage in the discarded timeline; another ally never learned about it. | The witness can retain that memory if eligible through the invoking Oracle's snapshot alliance. The other ally receives no automatic knowledge. The witness can tell them normally. |

An unavailable restore spends neither the Reaction nor the long-rest entitlement. The Director needs a complete, legal proposed state before resolving the ability; unresolved source interactions cannot be waived by calling a snapshot complete.

## Required integrations still missing

The minimum seventeen-domain review is not complete. Seven major integrations are unimplemented: actual concentration/transformation callbacks; Druid form and conserved recharge clocks; creature lifecycle/corpse/persistent assets; device lifecycle/stock/commands; remaining structures, Choir and control lifecycles; the complete FeatWorld; and source-qualified control/healing pulses. Even the implemented foundational domains are bounded by the input policies above. For example, the external concentration map is a dependency projection, not the callback-bearing live concentration adapter.

`TemporalKernel.support_report()` reports that limit. `playable_plan()` always rejects until the full implementation and independent review exist. `kernel_plan()` is a development fixture interface, not a replacement for the complete Oracle feature. The host must disclose every active integration. A supplied unsupported holder rejects preflight; an empty registration is not a certificate that a real game scene is complete.

`TemporalHealingCommitLedger` can be passed as the one canonical healing ledger to existing helpers. Its canonical return IDs preserve `FeatWorld.commit_healing` removal semantics, while its historical consumption tokens are iteration-qualified. Capture/preflight validate the live registry independently of `register()`: exact source/identity/absolute clock, canonical owner/target, boolean availability, and matching consumption-token/event history. External effect dictionary keys, effect identities, dependency identities and max-HP record identities must also agree. Agony creation/refresh/removal still needs the full feat adapter to synchronize active records; this kernel does not claim that synchronization exists.

## Abilities and training

Ability modifier = floor((score − 10) / 2), including negative results. For example, 8 gives −1, 13 gives +1 and 16 gives +3.

**Optional new candidate method:** 27-point buy, scores 8–15 before ancestry. Costs are 8:0, 9:1, 10:2, 11:3, 12:4, 13:5, 14:7, 15:9. Spend no more than 27 points across six scores; no score outside that range. This adopts the existing companion method as a provisional option, not a claim that the book already specified it.

Resolve duplicate training as follows:

- For a selectable grant, choose another eligible option from that grant’s own list.
- For a fixed ancestry/background skill grant with no alternative list, choose another of the 20 basic skills.
- For a duplicated tool, choose another eligible tool from that grant’s list; if it has no list, use another actually supported tool in the same broad category.
- Duplicate armor, weapon, save or multiclass chassis training gives no skill or feat compensation. A new multiclass skill selection must still use its own permitted list.
- Duplicate proficiency never creates Expertise unless an exact feature says so. If a proficiency grant requires a choice and every legal option for that grant is already possessed, that grant provides no additional proficiency. Character creation, multiclass entry or advancement remains legal. Do not substitute a feat, Expertise, another category of proficiency, an unrelated skill/tool, or a banked future selection. This applies to skill and tool lists, including a legal replacement list or category that is itself exhausted.

PB is applied once to a check even if a skill and tool both qualify. An exact Expertise multiplier modifies that one proficiency contribution; it does not add another independent PB.

exactEvidenceLocationsRead.excerpt:
# Unity and False Resonance — Director Canon

## Unity

**Unity** is false resonance: a counterfeit harmony created not by distinct voices acting together, but by removing meaningful distinction until alternatives disappear.

It can present itself through compassion, efficiency, prosperity, security, peace, equality, order, or collective purpose. None of those ideals is inherently corrupt. The danger begins when a system makes disagreement, exit, independent identity, or genuine alternative impossible.

True resonance preserves difference. False resonance consumes it.

## Cosmological Effect

Unity attacks the Matrix by collapsing:

**Difference → Conflict → Motion → History → Memory → Identity → Will**

The end state is not peaceful civilization. It is a zero-state in which nothing meaningfully chooses, differs, becomes, remembers, or wants.

## Goblins

Goblins are metaphysically **more susceptible to Unity than most mortal peoples**. This is a vulnerability, not a moral alignment.

Director guardrails:

- most goblins do not know Unity exists;
- susceptibility is not guilt;
- many goblins are unaffected;
- some goblins identify and oppose Unity more fiercely than anyone else;
- no goblin NPC should be treated as representative of the entire people;
- finance, banking, commerce, peace movements, and collectivist institutions are not automatically Unity.

Goblin civilization's talent for fast-moving networks, credit, bargains, salvage markets, expedition finance, insurance, and institutional coordination gives false resonance unusually powerful structures to exploit when it does take root.

Goblin financiers were among the founders of the **Aethel banking conglomerate** and remain major backers of dungeon expeditions, mercenary forces, salvage claims, and war credit. These institutions can generate true resonance through risk and competing choice—or become false-resonance vectors when participation hardens into dependency and alternatives disappear.

## Moloch and the Coinfather Pattern

Moloch did not invent goblin commerce and is not secretly behind every bank, contract, or war. He exploits existing systems.

The Coinfather pattern converts:

- value into surveillance;
- obligation into identity;
- prosperity into dependency;
- voluntary exchange into a structure from which meaningful exit becomes impossible.

A small number of financiers knowingly serve Moloch. Many more can reproduce parts of the pattern without understanding what they are doing.

Use this pattern sparingly. Ordinary greed, ordinary debt, ordinary corruption, and ordinary war must continue to exist independently or Unity becomes an explanation for everything and therefore explains nothing.

## The Ancient Anti-Goblin Crusade

The crusade is intentionally morally difficult.

Crusader records describe cult penetration, captured institutions, weaponized debt, expanding promises of compulsory peace, and a civilization-scale false-resonance threat. They may have correctly identified a genuine existential vector and may have believed eradication was the only reliable containment method available.

Goblin histories describe extermination, dispossession, collective punishment, and the destruction of communities that had no knowledge of Unity and in many cases opposed the implicated institutions.

Both bodies of evidence contain truth.

The setting should not force a clean answer that the crusade was either pure heroism or meaningless bigotry. The question it leaves Directors and players is harder: **how does a civilization respond to a real risk that is unevenly distributed among a people without converting susceptibility into collective guilt?**

Write important terms down. State what each side believes the wording means and what mechanism or witness enforces it. Allow players to exploit language when they earned the interpretation, but give intelligent NPCs the same opportunity. Do not spring clauses that no character could perceive or understand.

value.name: Death Ward

operational.targets: One living creature you can perceive within range and line of effect
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; ends when its prevention is used
operational.resolution: No initial save. While the spell remains active, the first eligible effect that would reduce the target from positive HP to 0 without Core Instant Death or another outright-death result instead leaves it at 1 HP; then the ward ends.
operational.effect: Prevent one positive-to-zero HP crossing. Preserve the raw damage packet, Core Instant Death check, half-maximum/Maiming Wound triggers and attached conditions. The prevented positive-to-zero crossing does not itself create a drop-only Wound save. This is loss prevention, not healing, so a cannot-regain-HP effect does not stop it. Other eligible survival effects are rechecked after the selected prevention resolves; no duplicate automatic use is consumed after the crossing has already been prevented.
operational.scaling: None. Always one eligible crossing and a 1-HP floor.
operational.limitations: Does not trigger while the target is already at 0. Does not resurrect, repair a vital body, prevent third death-save failure/fatal Wound death/lethal-track death or override explicitly unpreventable HP loss. Cannot legalize an otherwise unaffordable HP cost. If multiple independently owned wards exist, use only the chosen eligible prevention; unused records retain their own concentration/deadline. This is distinct from Cleric Ritual of Undeath's would-die replacement. Normal spell costs and risk apply.
operational.designNotes: Core Necromancy rank4, 7RP, Action, 60ft and concentration1minute retained with exact class gates. M/F uses the already-reviewed class-focus alternative; no unstated material cost. NEW: living target, explicit positive crossing, outright-death exclusion and competing-prevention procedure. The agreed damage/HP-loss interface is in the candidate guide; reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.
